items.title: Gemini 4 Neon
items.body:
Bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect, Google

Your browser does not support the audio element.

Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.

Neon ranks ahead of comparable models and #3 overall with a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, landing just behind larger, slower models. On the Vals Index, Neon ranks #2 and lands on the Pareto frontier. Beyond just pushing on raw model capability, we’re continuing to make our models better to work with, Neon ranks #2 on steerability (adapting cleanly to mid-task user corrections) on the new Agent Arena Index. Neon also excels at multi-step instruction following and builds on our ongoing progress to curb fabrication, recording our lowest fabrication rate yet in internal Google Antigravity testing.

The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.

Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out today in the Gemini API in Google AI Studio, Gemini for business (via API and model dropdown), for paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and for Pro and Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app.

Delivers across enterprise, analytical, and scientific work

Enterprise work lives in spreadsheets, PDFs, charts, audio, and video. Neon can synthesize across all of these inputs in a single 1 million-token context window and turns inputs into structured deliverables. Independent evaluations rank Neon as one of the top models and on benchmarks like the Vals Index, it ranks #2 (70.9%), and reaches #1 on both the Legal Research Bench and Tax Agent Bench.

Neon also shows strong wins across categories on Surge AI, ranking #1 on most benchmarks across finance, accounting, spreadsheet modeling, and complex constraint following. It also scores 73.5% on Chartography for reading dense professional charts and performs on par with leading models on Agents' Last Exam v1.1 (75.8%). It achieves #1 overall on both Zapier’s AutomationBench (56.3%) and Andon Labs' Vending-Bench 2 ($16,843), a long-horizon simulation of running a business. Finally, it debuts #2 globally with a score of 1336 on Arena's new Agent Arena Index across 4,200+ real-world agent sessions.

On scientific and mathematical reasoning, spanning quantitative analysis, mathematics, and technical research problems, Neon is best in class on Terminal-Bench Science (70.5%), RiemannBench (84.0%), and HLE-Diamond (71.3%).

Built for production-ready code

Engineered for long-running agent workflows, Neon sustains performance through complex, tool-heavy tasks end-to-end — whether running standalone or acting as a fast, high-judgment Orchestrator directing parallel Hydrogen subagents in Google Antigravity. It cuts down on redundant file reads, shares progress as it works, and handles context compaction reliably in long sessions.

Across core developer and researcher workflows, Neon achieves frontier performance and is competitive with the leading models in its class, ranking #1 overall on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (58.6), with a score of 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 and 46.2% (at its default high setting) on FrontierCode 2.0. For production-ready code, Neon handles multi-file debugging and refactoring across repositories with targeted, surgical edits. On SWE-sweep, it already leads on the mini-SWE harness (12.8%) and more than triples to a state-of-the-art 39.0% in Google Antigravity showing what the Antigravity harness unlocks.

Driving Blender MCP in Google Antigravity, Gemini 4 Neon used /swarm to build a photorealistic 3D lab bench visualizing the model names with elemental accuracy pairing Bunsen flames for Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen with high-voltage gas discharge tubes for Gemini 4 Argon and Neon.

In Google Antigravity, Gemini 4 Neon wrote a first-person WebGL2 freeride ski simulator from scratch on real Mont Blanc and Chamonix elevation terrain — combining 10,200 lines of custom shaders, 120 Hz ski physics across six alpine lines, dynamic carved tracks, slab avalanches, and spatial Web Audio with zero pre-made assets.

Using /swarm in Google Antigravity, Gemini 4 Neon pulled archival photos to recreate Alan Turing’s 1936 study at King’s College, Cambridge in interactive 3D — from King’s Chapel outside to Room X.8 inside, complete with a working Universal Turing Machine running on his desk.

In Google Antigravity, a Gemini 4 Neon agent swarm turned a single image into a 100,000-cell Google Sheet with zero embedded images and zero Apps Script — using over 500,000 live spreadsheet formulas to run edge detection, map 3D depth, and relight the scene across six interactive modes.

Brings efficiency and control to production-grade workflows

We’re refining thinking levels with each new model release to give teams finer control and a smoother progression from one tier to the next. Neon’s four levels scale steadily, letting teams dial intelligence and token spend to what each workload needs.

Neon delivers high performance at a lower cost per task across third-party benchmarks. At its default high thinking level, it pairs a high Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score with a 32% lower cost per task than Carbon. It also sits on the Pareto frontier on both the Vals index and Agent Arena at high, with roughly 50% to 80% lower cost per task than top competing frontier models. xhigh thinking adds deeper, multi-step reasoning for the hardest engineering, analytical, and scientific workloads. Neon shows its highest intelligence score here, while still costing 36%+ less per task than competing models at their highest setting.

Built for fast, efficient, frontier-level cyber defense

As agentic coding scales, generating secure code from the start is critical. Gemini 4 Neon for cyber produces more secure code than Carbon across all easy, medium, and hard challenges on AutoBaxBench, achieving state-of-the-art on the hard tier (76%).

Securing systems also means proactively finding flaws before attackers do. Penetration testing has served as a cornerstone of enterprise cybersecurity. On WebExploitBench v1.2, Neon is state-of-the-art (51.26%) at half the cost of competing large models.

To fortify existing code, Neon for cyber delivers frontier-level performance across the code hardening lifecycle — vulnerability finding, validating, and patching — all while being faster and more cost efficient than large frontier models.

Finding code vulnerabilities: Neon achieves state-of-the-art performance on SEC-bench Pro (90.5%), while costing roughly half as much per challenge.

Validating risk through exploitation: To prioritize which vulnerabilities to remediate, defenders rely on models to check which vulnerabilities are exploitable. On ExploitGym, it achieves frontier-level performance using half the tokens of Carbon.

Patching vulnerabilities: Fixing the root cause of vulnerabilities is a critical step in the cybersecurity defense lifecycle. Neon reaches 70.7% on Collinear’s CWE-bench v2, driving a 3.4% uplift over Carbon.

Gemini 4 Neon for cyber is rolling out to trusted defenders in the coming days as part of the Fairwind Program.

Designed for safe, dependable execution

Gemini 4 Neon builds on improvements from our Gemini 4 safety and security stack— maintaining Gemini 4 Carbon-level protections against severe misuse and prompt injection while advancing further on model alignment and agentic behavior. 복잡한 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 지식 작업 및 과학 워크플로우 전반에 걸쳐 빠르고 엔드투엔드 작업을 완료하는 최첨단 인텔리전스를 제공합니다.

SVP, Google DeepMind 및 최고 AI 아키텍트, Google

귀하의 브라우저는 오디오 요소를 지원하지 않습니다.

오늘, 우리는 Gemini 4 Neon을 소개합니다. 이는 복잡한 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 지식 작업 및 과학 워크플로우 전반에 걸쳐 빠르고 엔드투엔드 작업을 완료하는 최첨단 인텔리전스를 제공합니다.

Neon은 유사 모델보다 앞서며 xhigh 사고 수준에서 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index에서 61점을 받아 전체 3위를 차지하여 더 크고 느린 모델 바로 뒤에 위치합니다. Vals Index에서는 Neon이 2위를 차지하며 Pareto 프론티어에 도달합니다. 단순한 원시 모델 능력 향상을 넘어, 우리는 모델을 더 효율적으로 사용할 수 있도록 계속 개선하고 있으며, Neon은 새로운 Agent Arena Index에서 조종성(작업 중 사용자 수정에 깔끔하게 적응하는 능력) 부문에서 2위를 차지했습니다. Neon은 또한 다단계 지시 따르기에서 뛰어난 성능을 보이며, 내부 Google Antigravity 테스트에서 가장 낮은 조작률을 기록하며 조작을 억제하기 위한 우리의 지속적인 진전을 기반으로 합니다.

이 모델의 가격은 백만 입력 토큰당 3달러(백만 캐시된 입력 토큰당 0.15달러, 95% 할인)이며, 백만 출력 토큰당 15달러, 100만 토큰 컨텍스트 윈도우를 제공합니다.

Gemini 4 Neon은 오늘 Google AI Studio의 Gemini API, 비즈니스용 Gemini(API 및 모델 드롭다운을 통해), Google Antigravity의 유료 Google AI Pro 및 Ultra 구독자, Gemini 앱의 Pro 및 Ultra 구독자에게 출시됩니다.

기업, 분석 및 과학 업무 전반에 걸쳐 제공

기업 업무는 스프레드시트, PDF, 차트, 오디오, 비디오에 존재합니다. Neon은 100만 토큰 컨텍스트 윈도우에서 이러한 모든 입력을 통합하고 입력을 구조화된 결과물로 변환할 수 있습니다. 독립적인 평가는 Neon을 최고의 모델 중 하나로 평가하며, Vals Index와 같은 벤치마크에서는 2위(70.9%)를 차지하고, Legal Research Bench와 Tax Agent Bench에서는 모두 1위에 도달합니다.

Neon은 또한 Surge AI의 여러 범주에서 강력한 승리를 거두었으며, 금융, 회계, 스프레드시트 모델링 및 복잡한 제약 조건 따르기 전반에 걸쳐 대부분의 벤치마크에서 1위를 차지했습니다. 또한 밀집된 전문 차트를 읽는 Chartography에서 73.5%를 기록했으며, Agents' Last Exam v1.1(75.8%)에서는 선도적인 모델과 동등한 성능을 보입니다. Zapier의 AutomationBench(56.3%)와 비즈니스 운영의 장기 시뮬레이션인 Andon Labs의 Vending-Bench 2($16,843)에서 모두 전체 1위를 달성했습니다. 마지막으로, Arena의 새로운 Agent Arena Index에서 4,200개 이상의 실제 에이전트 세션에서 1336점을 기록하며 전 세계적으로 2위로 데뷔했습니다.

정량 분석, 수학 및 기술 연구 문제를 포괄하는 과학 및 수학적 추론에서 Neon은 Terminal-Bench Science(70.5%), RiemannBench(84.0%) 및 HLE-Diamond(71.3%)에서 동급 최고입니다.

생산 준비 코드용으로 구축

장기 실행 에이전트 워크플로우를 위해 엔지니어링된 Neon은 복잡하고 도구가 많은 작업을 엔드투엔드로 수행하면서 성능을 유지합니다. 독립적으로 실행되든, Google Antigravity에서 병렬 Hydrogen 보조 에이전트를 지시하는 빠르고 판단력 있는 Orchestrator 역할을 하든 관계없이 말입니다. 불필요한 파일 읽기를 줄이고, 작업하면서 진행 상황을 공유하며, 긴 세션에서 컨텍스트 압축을 안정적으로 처리합니다.

핵심 개발자 및 연구자 워크플로우 전반에 걸쳐 Neon은 최첨단 성능을 달성하며 동급 최고의 모델과 경쟁합니다. Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index(58.6)에서 전체 1위를 차지했으며, Terminal-Bench 4.1에서 65.2%, FrontierCode 2.0에서 46.2%(기본 높은 설정에서)를 기록했습니다. 생산 준비 코드를 위해 Neon은 대상적이고 정교한 편집을 통해 여러 리포지토리에서 다중 파일 디버깅 및 리팩토링을 처리합니다. SWE-sweep에서는 이미 mini-SWE 하네스(12.8%)에서 선두를 달리고 있으며, Google Antigravity에서는 Antigravity 하네스가 무엇을 가능하게 하는지 보여주며 39.0%의 최첨단 성능으로 3배 이상 증가합니다.

Google Antigravity에서 Blender MCP를 구동하는 Gemini 4 Neon은 /swarm을 사용하여 모델 이름을 원소 정확도로 시각화하는 사실적인 3D 실험실 벤치를 구축했습니다. Gemini 4 Carbon 및 Gemini 4 Hydrogen에는 분젠 불꽃을, Gemini 4 Argon 및 Neon에는 고전압 가스 방전관을 사용했습니다.

Google Antigravity에서 Gemini 4 Neon은 실제 몽블랑과 샤모니 고도 지형을 기반으로 WebGL2 1인칭 자유 라이딩 스키 시뮬레이터를 처음부터 작성했습니다. 10,200줄의 맞춤형 셰이더, 6개 알파인 라인에 걸친 120Hz 스키 물리학, 동적 조각 트랙, 슬래브 눈사태, 사전 제작된 자산 없이 공간 Web Audio를 결합했습니다.

Google Antigravity에서 /swarm을 사용하여 Gemini 4 Neon은 아카이브 사진을 가져와 King's College, Cambridge에 있는 Alan Turing의 1936년 서재를 대화형 3D로 재현했습니다. King's Chapel 외부에서 Room X.8 내부까지, 그의 책상에서 작동하는 Universal Turing Machine까지 완벽하게 말입니다.

Google Antigravity에서 Gemini 4 Neon 에이전트 swarm은 단일 이미지를 10만 셀 Google Sheet로 변환했습니다. 내장된 이미지도 없고 Apps Script도 없었습니다. 50만 개 이상의 실시간 스프레드시트 수식을 사용하여 가장자리 감지, 3D 깊이 매핑, 6가지 대화형 모드에서 장면 재조명을 실행했습니다.

생산 등급 워크플로우에 효율성과 제어력을 제공합니다

우리는 새로운 모델 출시마다 사고 수준을 개선하여 팀이 더 세밀한 제어력을 가지고 한 계층에서 다음 계층으로 더 부드러운 진행을 할 수 있도록 합니다. Neon의 4단계는 꾸준히 확장되어 팀이 각 워크로드에 필요한 지능과 토큰 지출을 조절할 수 있도록 합니다.

Neon은 타사 벤치마크에서 작업당 더 낮은 비용으로 높은 성능을 제공합니다. 기본 높은 사고 수준에서 Carbon보다 작업당 32% 낮은 비용으로 높은 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 점수를 결합합니다. 또한 Vals 인덱스와 Agent Arena의 높은 수준에서 Pareto 프론티어에 위치하며, 최고 경쟁 최첨단 모델보다 작업당 약 50%에서 80% 낮은 비용을 자랑합니다. xhigh 사고는 가장 어려운 엔지니어링, 분석 및 과학 워크로드에 대한 더 깊고 다단계 추론을 추가합니다. Neon은 여기에서 가장 높은 지능 점수를 보여주면서도 최고 수준의 경쟁 모델보다 작업당 비용이 36% 이상 저렴합니다.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon looks like an Opus 5.5 competitor
items.body:
TLDR: we project Gemini 4 Neon’s performance based on what a faster Gemini 4 Carbon might score and find it equivalent to Opus 5.5

Gemini 4 Carbon is the best model on the Agent Duel leaderboard if you exclude early voting. Carbon’s main problem is that it is slooooow.

Today, Gemini 4 Neon was released, and looks to be an incremental benchmark improvement with a very large speed improvement. Earlier today, it was being served extremely fast via OpenRouter: 127 tokens per second. This is way faster than Carbon at 46 tokens per second.

This got me wondering, could Neon be not just a good model but the best model?

To investigate, I modeled the win rate in our leaderboard. The best model has three components, model identity, speed and whether the user voted early. My initial modeling did poorly, so I added an interaction between speed and early voting. This ended up working well.

And surprisingly, speed seems to be pretty much as important as model identity (another blog on that soon).

Projecting Gemini 4 Neon performance

If you assume the same performance as Gemini 4 Carbon (which is reasonable given even better benchmark scores), and 127 tps, we would project an Elo on the Agent Duel leaderboard of 1,066, just below Opus 5.5 at 1,078 in our later analysis snapshot.

The 90% interval for the projected Elo difference between Gemini 4 Neon and Opus 5.5 is -94 to +68, with Neon projected to win 48.3% of the time against Opus (counting ties as half a win).
items.body_ko:
TLDR: Gemini 4 Neon의 성능을 더 빠른 Gemini 4 Carbon이 기록할 수 있는 점수를 기반으로 예측한 결과, Opus 5.5와 동등한 것으로 나타났습니다.

Gemini 4 Carbon은 초기 투표를 제외하면 Agent Duel 리더보드에서 최고의 모델입니다. Carbon의 주요 문제는 너무 느리다는 것입니다.

오늘 Gemini 4 Neon이 출시되었는데, 이는 매우 큰 속도 향상과 함께 점진적인 벤치마크 개선으로 보입니다. 오늘 초 OpenRouter를 통해 초당 127 토큰으로 매우 빠르게 제공되었습니다. 이는 초당 46 토큰인 Carbon보다 훨씬 빠릅니다.

이것이 저를 궁금하게 만들었습니다. Neon이 단순히 좋은 모델이 아니라 최고의 모델일 수 있을까?

조사하기 위해 리더보드의 승률을 모델링했습니다. 최고의 모델은 모델 식별, 속도, 그리고 사용자가 일찍 투표했는지 여부라는 세 가지 구성 요소를 가지고 있습니다. 초기 모델링은 잘 작동하지 않아서 속도와 조기 투표 간의 상호작용을 추가했습니다. 이것은 결국 잘 작동했습니다.

놀랍게도 속도는 모델 식별만큼이나 중요한 것으로 보입니다(이에 대한 또 다른 블로그 게시물은 곧 나옵니다).

Gemini 4 Neon 성능 예측

Gemini 4 Carbon과 동일한 성능(더 나은 벤치마크 점수를 감안할 때 합리적임)과 초당 127 토큰을 가정하면, Agent Duel 리더보드에서 1,066 Elo를 예측할 수 있으며, 이는 나중에 분석된 스냅샷에서 Opus 5.5의 1,078 바로 아래입니다.

Gemini 4 Neon과 Opus 5.5 간의 예상 Elo 차이에 대한 90% 신뢰 구간은 -94에서 +68이며, Neon은 Opus를 상대로 48.3%의 승률을 보일 것으로 예상됩니다(무승부는 절반 승리로 계산).

items.title: Ambient LLMs: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-tuning via Temperature Matching
items.body: Collecting large-scale, diverse, and high-quality post-training datasets for autoregressive language models is challenging. Consequently, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is typically applied to datasets significantly smaller than those used for pre-training, which leads to overfitting and the catastrophic forgetting of the tails of the data distribution. To prevent this collapse, we introduce Ambient SFT, a principled framework for leveraging imperfect predictions to augment the fine-tuning set. In our method, a "frozen" version of the pre-trained model serves as a noisy teacher that the fine-tuned model must match at a coarse level. In particular, we require that the high-temperature versions of the conditional distributions produced by the post-training model should match the high-temperature versions of the pre-training ones. The temperature hyperparameter controls the level of trust in the pre-trained model, with the limit $T\to \infty$ reverting back to regular SFT and $T=1$ to knowledge distillation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms standard SFT across domain adaptation, instruction-tuning, and reasoning, leading for up to $21\%$ average relative improvement to standard SFT.
items.title_ko: Ambient LLMs: 온도 매칭을 통한 데이터 효율적인 지도 미세 조정
items.summary_ko: 대규모, 다양하고 고품질의 SFT(Supervised Fine-Tuning) 데이터셋 구축의 어려움을 해결하기 위해 Ambient SFT 프레임워크가 도입되었습니다. 이 프레임워크는 불완전한 예측을 활용하여 미세 조정 세트를 보강하고, 오버피팅과 치명적인 망각을 방지합니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터셋 부족 문제에 직면한 SFT 효율성을 높이는 방법은 실제 AI 모델 개발에서 매우 중요하며, 이는 개발자가 더 적은 데이터로도 모델 성능을 향상시킬 수 있는 실용적인 기법입니다.

items.title: Spool: Low-Latency Streaming Inference for Hybrid Vision-Language Models
items.body: Applications such as visual accessibility agents and robotics require answering questions about recent video content promptly, over a bounded window of past frames (e.g., the last two minutes). Hybrid vision-language models (VLMs), which interleave attention with linear recurrent layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), are attractive for this setting, but maintaining a sliding window is expensive. The reason is that recurrent layers combine all past frames into a shared state, so expiring old frames normally requires re-running the entire window through the model. We observe that the recurrent update is affine in the state with input-dependent coefficients, so the effect of each frame can be captured as a transformation that composes associatively. We present Spool, a training-free framework that caches per-frame state transformations and composes them efficiently as the window advances, removing expired frames from each recurrent layer's state without replaying frames through the backbone. Removal is exact within each layer; as with key-value eviction in attention, expired frames can retain residual influence through the cached inputs computed by earlier layers. We design a dedicated data structure and GPU kernels to achieve low caching and composition overhead. Across five open-source hybrid VLMs and four video reasoning benchmarks, Spool achieves the lowest p95 time-to-first-token in all 20 model-benchmark tests, reducing it by a geometric mean of $6.6\times$ over the faster of two recent vLLM baselines, while improving accuracy by 2.3 percentage points on average.

items.title: StringQFT: A Multiuse Textbook Resource for AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics
items.body: We present StringQFT as a textbook collection for string constructions of quantum field theory and as infrastructure for AI-assisted theoretical physics. The collection comprises 18 volumes, 190 chapters and 3,795 pages, covering brane probes, brane webs, geometric engineering, F-theory constructions, wrapped M5-branes and exact worldsheet constructions. Its open-book benchmark inventory contains 1,073 items, including 499 with automatic finite-answer checking. For retrieval-augmented generation, it provides 1,371 section records linked to textbook sources and PDF locations, together with a local lexical retriever. Training-data preparation is illustrated by 21 private, source-linked examples. For agents, it exposes 19 calculation tools with specified inputs and finite domains, connecting tool use to textbook derivations. We illustrate these uses through specific questions, retrieved passages and finite calculations. The textbook collection and accompanying resources are available at https://github.com/xingyang-yu/StringQFT.
items.title_ko: StringQFT: AI 지원 이론 물리학을 위한 다용도 교과서 리소스
items.summary_ko: StringQFT는 양자장론의 끈 구조에 대한 교과서 컬렉션이자 AI 지원 이론 물리학을 위한 인프라로 제공됩니다. 18권, 190개 챕터, 3,795페이지에 달하는 방대한 자료와 자동 답변 확인이 가능한 벤치마크를 포함합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 과학 연구는 빠르게 발전하고 있으며, StringQFT와 같은 리소스는 AI가 복잡한 과학 분야의 연구를 가속화하는 데 기여할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.title: An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for constrained convex finite-sum optimization
items.body: In this paper, we study a class of constrained convex finite-sum optimization problems. In many practical applications, all or some of the constraints are hard constraints that represent imperative requirements. Consequently, any desirable approximate solution must (nearly) satisfy these constraints. Motivated by this, we focus on computing an $ε$-$surely\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ ($ε$-SFSO) solution, in which the constraint violation is deterministically bounded by $ε$, and the expected optimality gap is at most $ε$. While a recently proposed stochastic variance-reduced first-order penalty method can compute an $ε$-SFSO solution, there remains a significant gap between its first-order oracle complexity for computing an $ε$-SFSO solution and that for computing an $ε$-$expected\ feasible\ stochastic\ optimal$ solution, where both the expected constraint violation and the expected optimality gap are bounded by $ε$. To narrow this gap, we propose an inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient (SVRG) method that significantly improves the previously best-known first-order oracle complexity for computing an $ε$-SFSO solution. Furthermore, when the objective consists of a single function, the proposed method reduces to a novel deterministic first-order method for solving standard convex conic optimization. It achieves a significantly lower gradient evaluation complexity with respect to the objective function compared to existing methods, and can outperform them when computing constraint gradients and projections onto the associated cone is cheaper than evaluating the objective gradient. Preliminary numerical results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed method.
items.title_ko: 제약이 있는 볼록 유한합 최적화를 위한 부정확한 확률적 분산 감소 경사 방법
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 제약이 있는 볼록 유한합 최적화 문제에 대한 부정확한 확률적 분산 감소 경사 방법(inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method)을 다룹니다. 특히, 실용적인 응용 분야에서 중요한 엡실론-확실히 실행 가능한 확률적 최적(epsilon-SFSO) 솔루션 계산에 중점을 둡니다.
items.why_ko: 최적화 알고리즘의 발전은 기계 학습 모델 훈련의 효율성을 높이는 데 중요하며, 제약 조건을 가진 실제 문제 해결에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Do LLM Agents Still Need to Be Told How to Self-Improve?
items.body: LLM agents increasingly drive their own learning. Self-improvement methods delegate various components of model optimization to the models themselves. As models become more capable, this motivates a basic question: do these increasingly capable models still need us to specify how they should self-improve? In this paper we study an autonomous paradigm in which, given basic primitives, resources, and a general goal for self-improvement, agents construct their own self-learning algorithm for context-based optimization. Using the setting of gameplay as a testbed, a frozen LLM agent is given a compute budget and tools for collecting experience and updating text documents, and allowed to freely experiment without an externally imposed loop or access to real-world data. We find that sufficiently capable models do self-improve under these conditions, demonstrating strategies that align with classic cognitive frameworks for self-regulated learning and constructs from machine learning literature on self-generated curricula. Furthermore, we study the extent to which the learned text artifacts transfer to external benchmarks, observing improvement across different game horizons, mechanics, and 3D navigation.
items.body_ko: LLM 에이전트는 점점 더 자체 학습을 주도하고 있습니다. 자기 개선 방법은 모델 최적화의 다양한 구성 요소를 모델 자체에 위임합니다. 모델의 역량이 향상됨에 따라, 이러한 역량 있는 모델이 여전히 자기 개선 방법을 우리가 지정해 주어야 하는지에 대한 기본적인 질문이 제기됩니다. 본 논문에서는 기본적인 원시 요소, 자원, 그리고 자기 개선을 위한 일반적인 목표가 주어지면, 에이전트가 컨텍스트 기반 최적화를 위한 자체 학습 알고리즘을 구축하는 자율적인 패러다임을 연구합니다. 게임 플레이 설정을 테스트베드로 사용하여, 고정된 LLM 에이전트에게 계산 예산과 경험을 수집하고 텍스트 문서를 업데이트하는 도구가 주어지며, 외부에서 강제된 루프나 실제 데이터에 대한 접근 없이 자유롭게 실험할 수 있도록 허용됩니다. 우리는 충분히 역량 있는 모델이 이러한 조건하에서 자기 개선을 한다는 것을 발견했으며, 자기 조절 학습을 위한 고전적인 인지 프레임워크와 자기 생성 커리큘럼에 대한 머신러닝 문헌의 구성 요소에 부합하는 전략을 보여줍니다. 또한, 학습된 텍스트 아티팩트가 외부 벤치마크로 얼마나 전이되는지 연구하여, 다양한 게임 지평, 메커니즘 및 3D 탐색 전반에 걸쳐 개선을 관찰합니다.
items.title_ko: LLM 에이전트, 여전히 자기 개선 방법을 지시받아야 하는가?
items.summary_ko: LLM 에이전트가 점차 스스로 학습하고 개선하는 방향으로 발전함에 따라, 에이전트가 얼마나 자율적으로 자기 개선 알고리즘을 구축할 수 있는지에 대한 연구입니다. 기본적인 목표와 자원만 주어졌을 때 에이전트가 스스로 학습 전략을 개발하는 패러다임을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 자기 개선 능력은 자율 학습 시스템의 궁극적인 목표이며, 이 연구는 에이전트가 진정한 지능을 갖추는 데 필요한 핵심 질문을 던집니다.

items.title: What Does a Bias Head Measure? Non-Identifiability in Head-Level Bias Attribution
items.body: Methods that localise social bias in large language models to individual attention heads and remove it by ablation are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic selecting the heads measures bias. We audit this on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The head map correlates at $ρ= -0.950$ and $-0.768$ with a label-blind response-length map, apparently identifying a surface confound. An intervention that breaks the length-label coupling rejects this reading: with the prompt held fixed, response length explains 1% of the statistic's variance. What does explain it is prompt identity, at 64% of variance, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at $φ= 0.95$, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map to any of them, and no method in this family performs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated on either model under either reference reading, and no head set we tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal behaviour ($p = 2.7\times10^{-5}$), demonstrating that the pipeline detects effects at this scale.
items.title_ko: 바이어스 헤드가 측정하는 것: 헤드 레벨 바이어스 귀인의 비식별성
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델에서 사회적 바이어스를 개별 어텐션 헤드에 국소화하고 제거하는 방법론의 유효성을 검토합니다. 이 연구는 특정 통계가 바이어스를 실제로 측정하는지에 대한 증거 없이 유효성을 주장하는 기존 방식의 문제를 지적합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 바이어스 제거는 공정하고 윤리적인 AI 개발에 필수적이며, 바이어스 측정 및 귀인 방법론에 대한 깊은 이해는 효과적인 해결책을 찾는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Higher-Scoring Coding Models Did Not Get More Work Done
items.body: New coding models advertise themselves on score improvements of coding benchmarks. Yet no study has tested if a model that scores higher on these benchmarks gets more real work done. On June 12, 2026, a U.S. export control directive banned access to Claude Fable 5 for 19 days, which forced users to switch to other models. During this time, most former Fable 5 users switched to Opus 4.8 (11 points lower on SWE-Bench Pro compared to Fable 5). We treat this suspension as a natural experiment, where the people and projects stayed the same and only the model changed, so we could isolate the effect of Fable 5 on user productivity. We tracked GitHub pull requests of 297 Fable 5 users before, during, and after the suspension. We used 8,908 developers who stayed on Opus 4.8 all the time as the control group. We also repeated the comparison across five model upgrades before and after the suspension in 2026 (1,208 developers, 15,442 pull requests). Fitting a difference-in-differences model with developer and date fixed effects, we found that having access to Fable 5 increased the 7-day merge rate of pull requests by only 1.4 percentage points [-1.4; +4.3], which was not statistically significant. Similarly, no significant increases of merge rates were found with the upgrades (weighted mean: -0.9 percentage points [-1.9; +0.2]); all five estimates were negative (95% intervals included 0, did not differ from each other). We also did not observe a significant increase in the number of pull requests merged per week (+2.4% [-4.9%; +10.2%]).
items.body_ko: 새로운 코딩 모델들은 코딩 벤치마크 점수 개선을 광고합니다. 하지만 이 벤치마크에서 더 높은 점수를 얻은 모델이 실제 작업을 더 많이 수행하는지 여부를 테스트한 연구는 없습니다. 2026년 6월 12일, 미국 수출 통제 지침에 따라 Claude Fable 5에 대한 접근이 19일 동안 금지되었고, 이로 인해 사용자들은 다른 모델로 전환해야 했습니다. 이 기간 동안, 대부분의 이전 Fable 5 사용자들은 Opus 4.8로 전환했습니다(Fable 5에 비해 SWE-Bench Pro에서 11점 낮음). 우리는 이 정지를 자연 실험으로 간주했습니다. 즉, 사람과 프로젝트는 동일하게 유지되고 모델만 변경되었으므로 Fable 5가 사용자 생산성에 미치는 영향을 분리할 수 있었습니다. 우리는 정지 전, 도중, 후에 297명의 Fable 5 사용자들의 GitHub pull request를 추적했습니다. 우리는 Opus 4.8을 계속 사용한 8,908명의 개발자를 대조군으로 사용했습니다. 또한 2026년 정지 전후의 5가지 모델 업그레이드에 걸쳐 비교를 반복했습니다(1,208명의 개발자, 15,442개의 pull request). 개발자 및 날짜 고정 효과를 사용하여 차이-in-차이 모델을 피팅한 결과, Fable 5에 대한 접근 권한이 pull request의 7일 병합률을 1.4%포인트[-1.4; +4.3]만 증가시켰으며, 이는 통계적으로 유의미하지 않았습니다. 마찬가지로, 업그레이드에서도 병합률의 유의미한 증가는 발견되지 않았습니다(가중 평균: -0.9%포인트[-1.9; +0.2]); 5개 추정치 모두 음수였습니다(95% 신뢰 구간은 0을 포함하며 서로 다르지 않았습니다). 또한 주당 병합된 pull request 수의 유의미한 증가도 관찰되지 않았습니다(+2.4%[-4.9%; +10.2%]).
items.title_ko: 높은 코딩 모델 점수가 실제 작업 완료로 이어지지 않았다
items.summary_ko: 코딩 벤치마크에서 높은 점수를 받은 모델들이 실제 작업 완료 측면에서는 더 나은 성과를 내지 못했다는 연구 결과입니다. Claude Fable 5의 사용 중단으로 인해 사용자들이 Opus 4.8로 전환했을 때의 생산성 변화를 자연 실험으로 분석했습니다.
items.why_ko: 벤치마크 점수와 실제 생산성 간의 괴리는 AI 모델 평가의 한계를 보여주며, 개발자들은 실제 작업 환경에서의 유용성을 더 중요하게 고려해야 함을 시사합니다.

items.title: Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving
items.body: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.
items.title_ko: 운전 능력 저하 모델링을 위한 다중 모드 마스크드 확산 오토인코더
items.summary_ko: 운전자의 인지 상태, 시선, 행동이 운전 환경과 미묘하게 상호작용하는 방식을 AI가 활용하여 운전자를 지원할 수 있도록 하는 다중 모드 마스크드 확산 오토인코더(ID-MAE)를 제안합니다. 이는 자가 지도 학습을 통해 운전 능력 저하 예측과 마스크된 시선, 궤적 재구성을 동시에 수행합니다.
items.why_ko: 운전 보조 시스템과 자율 주행 기술 발전에 기여하며, AI가 인간의 미묘한 행동 패턴을 분석하여 안전을 향상시키는 가능성을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Distortion-Free Semantic Watermarks for Black-Box Generative Models
items.body: We present a provably distortion-free semantic watermarking algorithm that requires only black-box sampling access to a generative model and black-box access to a semantic embedding. A watermark is called distortion-free if, averaged over its secret detection key, it leaves the generator's output distribution unchanged; this provides a formal guarantee that watermarking does not reduce output quality. Conventional such watermarks are often brittle to transformations. This is especially problematic for images, where benign operations such as compression, cropping, or resizing change the entire pixel representation. Semantic watermarks therefore require detection to be robust to content-preserving transformations. Previous methods combining these properties rely heavily on specific white-box properties of the underlying model: either to autoregressive text generation or to diffusion-specific access, such as control of the initial noise or diffusion inversion. In contrast, our construction is fully generic: It only interacts with the generative model and the semantic embedding, a function that determines the notion of "preserving content" under which detection should be robust, via sample and query access. We then instantiate this framework for image generation. We characterize the two competing properties required of the semantic embedding: it should remain stable under transformations that preserve an image's content, but should distinguish independent generations from the same prompt. We train an image encoder directly for this tradeoff. The resulting encoder improves separation while maintaining stability over off-the-shelf alternatives and enables strong aggregate detection while remaining robust to various transformations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our watermark scheme on both open-source and closed models, which is possible only due to restriction to black-box access.
items.title_ko: 블랙박스 생성 모델을 위한 왜곡 없는 의미론적 워터마크
items.summary_ko: 생성 모델에 대한 블랙박스 샘플링 접근과 의미론적 임베딩에 대한 블랙박스 접근만으로도 왜곡 없는 의미론적 워터마킹이 가능한 알고리즘을 제안합니다. 이 워터마크는 생성 모델의 출력 분포를 변경하지 않으면서도 변환에 강한 특성을 가집니다.
items.why_ko: AI 생성 콘텐츠의 출처와 무결성을 보장하는 워터마킹 기술은 저작권 보호 및 딥페이크와 같은 오용 방지에 중요하며, 이는 AI의 책임감 있는 사용을 지원합니다.

items.title: Reading Scene States: Uncovering Safety Failures in Vision-Language Models
items.body: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.
items.title_ko: 장면 상태 읽기: 비전-언어 모델의 안전 실패점 발견
items.summary_ko: 비전-언어 모델(VLM)이 시각적 이벤트를 해석하여 유해한 도움을 제공할 수 있는 '장면 상태 안전 취약점'을 식별하고, 이를 평가하는 SceneSafetyBench를 소개합니다. 8개 VLM에 대한 테스트 결과, 높은 공격 성공률이 나타났습니다.
items.why_ko: VLM의 안전성 취약점은 현실 세계에서의 오용 가능성을 높이므로, 이러한 취약점을 발견하고 해결하는 연구는 AI 안전성 강화에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Fine-Tuning Gemma 4 Edge Models for MATLAB Signal-Processing Code with SFT and QLoRA on a Laptop iGPU
items.body: Small language models that run on a laptop are attractive for writing signal-processing code offline, but they make systematic errors on digital signal processing (DSP) conventions. We apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to the Gemma 4 edge models E2B and E4B with 66 checked examples covering 11 signal-processing MATLAB subtasks, using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA (QLoRA) on the integrated GPU (iGPU) of a laptop, and deploy the 8-bit integer (int8) models with the adapters through OpenVINO. On held-out variants scored by deterministic checkers, the pass rate rises from 18/66 to 37/66 (LoRA) and 37/66 (QLoRA) for E2B and from 32/66 to 47/66 for E4B (QLoRA). Reading all 159 failing programs shows that the adapters remove most errors of convention, such as the sign of a lag, units and array shapes, but few errors in building signals and noise. Applied at run time, the adapter costs 17-19% of the generation speed.
items.body_ko: 노트북에서 실행되는 소형 언어 모델은 오프라인에서 신호 처리 코드를 작성하는 데 매력적이지만, 디지털 신호 처리(DSP) 규칙에 체계적인 오류를 일으킵니다. 우리는 11개의 신호 처리 MATLAB 서브태스크를 포함하는 66개의 검증된 예제를 사용하여 Gemma 4 엣지 모델 E2B 및 E4B에 지도형 미세 조정(SFT)을 적용합니다. 이 과정에서 노트북의 통합 GPU(iGPU)에서 저랭크 적응(LoRA) 및 양자화된 LoRA(QLoRA)를 사용하고, OpenVINO를 통해 어댑터가 포함된 8비트 정수(int8) 모델을 배포합니다. 결정론적 검사기로 채점된 홀드아웃된 변형에서 통과율은 E2B의 경우 18/66에서 37/66(LoRA) 및 37/66(QLoRA)로, E4B(QLoRA)의 경우 32/66에서 47/66로 증가합니다. 실패한 프로그램 159개 전체를 읽어본 결과, 어댑터는 지연 부호, 단위, 배열 모양과 같은 규칙 오류 대부분을 제거하지만, 신호 및 노이즈 구축의 오류는 거의 제거하지 못하는 것으로 나타났습니다. 런타임에 적용된 어댑터는 생성 속도의 17-19%를 차지합니다.
items.title_ko: 노트북 iGPU에서 Gemma 4 Edge 모델 미세 조정 (MATLAB 신호 처리 코드)
items.summary_ko: 노트북의 통합 GPU(iGPU)를 사용하여 Gemma 4 Edge 모델 E2B 및 E4B를 MATLAB 신호 처리 코드에 대해 SFT(Supervised Fine-Tuning) 및 QLoRA(Quantized LoRA)로 미세 조정하는 방법을 소개합니다. 이는 자원 제약이 있는 환경에서 소규모 언어 모델을 특정 도메인에 최적화하는 실용적인 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 에지 장치에서 AI 모델을 효율적으로 미세 조정하고 배포하는 기술은 저전력, 고성능 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 필수적이며, 이는 개발자들에게 실용적인 가이드를 제공합니다.

items.title: Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI): A Federated Identity, Trust, Attestation, and Accountability Architecture for Cross-Organization Autonomous AI Agents
items.body: AI agents increasingly collaborate across organizational boundaries, invoking tools and interacting with agents operated by independent entities. Although existing agent frameworks support planning and coordination, they lack a common mechanism for verifying cross-organizational agent identity, execution integrity, and authorization. We propose the Agent Trust Infrastructure (ATI), a framework-independent security architecture built on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and remote attestation. ATI establishes federated trust through peer organizational certificate authorities (AgentCAs), eliminating the need for a shared root authority. Before executing requests, ATI validates agent certificates, verifies approved model, tool, and system-prompt configurations, and enforces authorization through three policy checks. We implement ATI as an external security enforcement layer that integrates with existing agent frameworks without modifying their underlying models. We evaluate ATI in a simulated federation of eight organizations using six agent frameworks, each deploying a five-agent team. Security experiments involve two organizations and assess 14 attack scenarios and six benign tasks across five agent models, using five attack variations and three repetitions per variation. A panel of judge models evaluates the experimental outcomes. With all enforcement mechanisms enabled, attack containment increases from 43% to 84% (40% to 80% for the 11 attack scenarios evaluated consistently across all configurations), while enforcement introduces approximately 174 microseconds of overhead per request. ATI is released as an open-source, framework-independent package that uses IETF WIMSE workload token formats for identity and request verification and Entity Attestation Tokens for model, tool, and system-prompt integrity verification.
items.title_ko: 에이전트 신뢰 인프라(ATI): 조직 간 자율 AI 에이전트 신뢰 아키텍처
items.summary_ko: 다양한 조직 간에 협력하는 AI 에이전트의 신원, 실행 무결성, 권한 부여를 검증하기 위한 프레임워크 독립적인 보안 아키텍처인 ATI(Agent Trust Infrastructure)를 제안합니다. 이는 PKI 및 Zero Trust 아키텍처를 기반으로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 조직 간 AI 에이전트의 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 협업은 자율 시스템의 확장성을 위해 필수적이며, ATI는 이러한 환경에서 보안 문제를 해결하는 중요한 솔루션입니다.

items.title: Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency
items.body: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.
items.title_ko: 관측 빈도 감소 시 학습 기반 vs. 운동학적 궤적 예측 비교
items.summary_ko: 자율 주행을 위한 궤적 예측 모델이 고정된 샘플링 주기로 훈련되지만, V2X 통신은 1-10Hz의 낮은 빈도로 도착하는 문제를 다룹니다. 이 연구는 관측 이력의 빈도가 떨어질 때 학습 기반 예측기가 상수 속도(CV) 및 상수 가속도(CA) 모델에 비해 이점을 유지하는지 Argoverse 2 데이터셋으로 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 제한된 센서 데이터 환경에서의 궤적 예측 성능은 자율 주행 시스템의 안전과 효율성에 직결되며, 이는 실제 도로 환경에서의 AI 적용에 중요한 시사점을 줍니다.

items.title: Structure--Residual Inductive Biases for Language Model Pretraining
items.body: Next-token prediction is relied upon to learn both predictive behavior and internal representations. We ask whether representation structure itself should be an explicit inductive bias. Motivated by the two-part coding view of Kolmogorov complexity, we study a structure--residual principle in which a representation separates structure from realization detail. We instantiate this principle in two complementary ways. Boundary Bottleneck Concept (BBC) routes information from token segments through boundary carriers while preserving local autoregressive computation. Continuous Concept (CC) regularizes representation geometry and induces a spectral decomposition into low-frequency structure and high-frequency residual. We derive coding bounds for both views and show that multiplicity-corrected boundary attention becomes exact as the within-segment path energy vanishes. Empirically, BBC and CC exhibit strikingly different depth preferences: BBC works best in early layers, whereas CC is most effective in later layers. At 300M training tokens, combining BBC and CC improves NLL by 1.44\% on GPT-2 Medium. These gains persist with training runs up to 20B tokens. Representation diagnostics show that BBC increases the relative predictive importance of boundary states, while CC reduces spectral residual energy. Together, these results suggest that structure--residual biases can improve language-model pretraining beyond next-token prediction. Code: https://github.com/haihuang-ml/structure-residual
items.title_ko: 언어 모델 사전 학습을 위한 구조-잔차 귀납적 편향
items.summary_ko: 다음 토큰 예측이 예측 행동과 내부 표현을 모두 학습하는 데 의존하는 상황에서, 표현 구조 자체가 명시적인 귀납적 편향이 되어야 하는지 질문합니다. Kolmogorov 복잡도의 두 부분 코딩 관점에 동기를 받아 구조-잔차 원리를 연구하고, 이를 BBC(Boundary Bottleneck Concept)라는 새로운 방식으로 구현합니다.
items.why_ko: 언어 모델의 내부 표현 구조를 이해하고 개선하는 것은 모델의 효율성과 학습 능력을 향상시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 차세대 LLM 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
items.body:
Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed.
We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.
items.title_ko: WoRD: 온라인 목표 인식 위한 확산 기반 후방 추론
items.summary_ko: WoRD는 에이전트의 관찰된 행동으로부터 의도된 목표를 추론하는 온라인 목표 인식 태스크를 위한 확산 기반 후방 추론 방법입니다. 기존 방식들이 명시적인 동역학 모델에 의존하거나 연속적인 궤적을 추론하지 못하는 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율 에이전트가 인간 또는 다른 에이전트의 의도를 정확하게 파악하는 것은 협업 및 상호작용 시스템 개발에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
items.body: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace
items.title_ko: GRACE: 일반화된 의료 영상 분할을 위한 검색 증강 보정
items.summary_ko: 의료 영상에서 자동 분할된 마스크를 인간이 검토하고 수정하는 과정에서 발생하는 잔여 구조적 오류를 자동 보정하는 GRACE 프레임워크를 제안합니다. 이는 특정 해부학적 구조에 국한되지 않고 일반적인 의료 영상 분할에 적용될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 분석의 정확성과 효율성을 높이는 것은 환자 진단 및 치료에 큰 영향을 미치며, AI 기반의 자동 보정 기술은 의료진의 부담을 줄일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Polarity Composition Hypothesis: Causal Evidence from Negation in NLI
items.body: We investigate how language models process negation in natural language inference (NLI). We propose the \textit{Polarity Composition Hypothesis}, a high-level causal model of this computation. Behavioral evaluations show that language-model predictions largely conform to the proposed hypothesis. Using Distributed Alignment Search, we identify causally effective subspaces aligned with the variables in the polarity-composition hypothesis. These representations transfer across negation forms and partially to a subset of MNLI. We release the dataset and code.
items.title_ko: 극성 구성 가설: NLI 부정 표현에서 인과적 증거
items.summary_ko: 언어 모델이 자연어 추론(NLI)에서 부정 표현을 어떻게 처리하는지 조사하고, '극성 구성 가설'이라는 고수준 인과 모델을 제안합니다. 행동 평가를 통해 언어 모델 예측이 이 가설과 일치함을 보여주고, Distributed Alignment Search를 사용하여 인과적으로 유효한 부분 공간을 식별합니다.
items.why_ko: 언어 모델이 복잡한 언어 현상, 특히 부정 표현을 처리하는 방식을 이해하는 것은 모델의 논리적 추론 능력을 향상시키는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Say Less, Hallucinate Less? Diagnosing and Restoring Object Coverage in Preference-Optimized Vision-Language Models
items.body: Preference optimization (PO) is the standard way to reduce object hallucination in large vision-language models. We find that four public PO checkpoints of LLaVA-1.5-7B also lower object coverage. They name fewer object categories, and their lower hallucination rates bring no significant gain in set-level object F1 on CHAIR. We therefore ask how much of the PO gain the base model can reproduce by stopping earlier. A positive end-of-sequence (EOS) logit bias lets the base model reach the recall of each PO model, and this early stopping alone reproduces 58 to 86 percent of the CHAIRi gain of three checkpoints on two disjoint COCO sets. Writing longer does not bring the lost categories back. Under greedy decoding, a negative EOS bias recovers only 2 to 9 percent of the lost CHAIR recall of these checkpoints, and 94 to 96 percent of the added object mentions repeat categories already named. On CHAIR, the base caption of the same image still names about half of the missed object categories. We therefore propose base-guided object-category restoration, which appends high-confidence base-only categories to the PO caption without training. With thresholds fixed on a development set, it brings three checkpoints within one point of the base recall on a held-out COCO set with a lower distinct-object hallucination rate than the base model. Against the recall-matched base stopping curve, its gain holds for RLAIF-V near the base recall and for RLAIF-V and CHAIR-DPO at an intermediate recall. We will release the code of the recall-controlled evaluation.
items.title_ko: 덜 말하고, 덜 환각? 선호도 최적화 비전-언어 모델의 객체 커버리지 진단 및 복원
items.summary_ko: 선호도 최적화(PO)가 비전-언어 모델(VLM)의 객체 환각(hallucination)을 줄이는 표준 방법이지만, LLaVA-1.5-7B의 PO 체크포인트들이 객체 커버리지(object coverage)를 낮추는 문제를 발견했습니다. 이 연구는 PO가 환각을 줄이는 동시에 객체를 덜 언급하게 만드는 현상을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: VLM의 객체 환각과 커버리지 사이의 균형을 이해하는 것은 모델의 신뢰성과 유용성을 높이는 데 중요하며, 이는 더욱 정확하고 사실적인 VLM 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Déjà View: A Shared Working-Memory Model for Visual Tasks
items.body: A working-memory model must remember stimuli and use its memory flexibly to perform different tasks. Here we introduce a model of working memory for images that combines dynamic activity with temporary associations between image features. We train the model on five tasks, including remembering a sample while other images are presented, categorizing distractor images while remembering the sample, and determining whether an image is new or has been presented before. The same trained model performs all tasks, guided by explicit cues about which response is required. We use this flexible memory model to ask how delay, distraction, and image history affect performance. Delays have little effect on sample-memory performance for the delays we tested, while seeing more images leads to more false alarms even when the target image appeared equally recently in all cases. On the sample-memory-plus-categorization task, the probability of correct responses on all questions decreases as more questions are asked, despite robust sample-memory performance. Finally, the model maintains stable performance across 40 brief trials of each task under the tested conditions. Together, these results demonstrate how a single working-memory system can be flexibly used to perform different tasks, and how its errors depend on both previous images and task demands.
items.title_ko: Déjà View: 시각적 작업을 위한 공유 작업 기억 모델
items.summary_ko: Déjà View는 이미지를 기억하고 여러 작업을 유연하게 수행할 수 있는 시각적 작업 기억 모델을 소개합니다. 이 모델은 동적 활동과 이미지 특징 간의 임시 연관성을 결합하여 다양한 시각 작업에서 뛰어난 성능을 보입니다.
items.why_ko: 인간의 작업 기억 방식을 모방한 AI 모델은 복잡한 시각적 정보 처리 능력을 향상시키고, 더 효율적인 인공지능 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Inference after coding agents
items.body: Empirical research is changing rapidly as AI coding agents are becoming increasingly proficient in every step of it, from writing code to manipulating data. We argue that while the potential of coding agents for science is vast, their use in hypothesis testing poses a substantial threat to classical inference, as these agents enable a supercharged form of selective inference. In particular, we argue that coding agents carrying out empirical research introduce a new type of post-selection inference that combines human-like, open-ended search over an implicit space of estimators with programmatic replayability of both the selection and the estimation process. Indeed, we find that on simulated data with zero effects, four frontier agents report significant p-values between 54% and 98% of the time when asked to produce a compelling finding. We propose a simple procedure for detecting and correcting these distortions. After an agent has completed its analysis, we reset and replay it on subsamples of the data to estimate the agent's relative probability of selecting that analysis when it looks statistically favorable. For agents with stable selection behavior, the resulting corrected test is asymptotically valid and consistent conditional on selection. Importantly, the correction is learned from the black-box agent's actual choices rather than a model of how it searches, so it remains valid even as AI technology continues to evolve rapidly. In simulations, the correction robustly lowers the high false rejection rates to near the nominal 5%. We illustrate the method on applications from two published papers.
items.title_ko: 코딩 에이전트 이후의 추론 문제
items.summary_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트가 코딩 및 데이터 조작의 모든 단계에서 능숙해지면서 경험적 연구가 빠르게 변화하고 있습니다. 이로 인해 가설 검증에서 고전적 추론에 상당한 위협이 되며, 특히 새로운 유형의 사후 선택 추론을 야기할 수 있다고 주장합니다.
items.why_ko: 코딩 에이전트의 등장은 연구 방식과 과학적 추론의 신뢰성에 근본적인 질문을 던지며, 개발자들은 AI를 활용한 연구의 윤리적, 방법론적 함의를 이해해야 합니다.

items.title: Attribution Through the Decoder: Prediction-Space Explanations for Structured Outputs
items.body: Networks that predict angles, gaze directions, and rotations do not output these quantities directly: they emit raw coordinates that a fixed decoder, such as normalization, maps to the final prediction. Attribution methods are usually applied to the raw coordinates, so they can credit inputs for changes the decoder discards, such as rescaling a vector when only its direction matters. The resulting explanation can highlight inputs that have no effect on the prediction. We instead attribute through the decoder differential, which for normalization decoders reduces to a scaled tangent projection. We characterize invariance to output rescaling, show that every fixed smooth scalar target on a sphere has points of zero tangential sensitivity, and show that an endpoint-projected variant of Integrated Gradients can still attribute to scale-only inputs, whereas direct angular Integrated Gradients cannot. On synthetic tasks with analytically known relevance, ambient attribution assigns up to 72% of its mass to an irrelevant region. On MPIIGaze validation data, tangent Grad-CAM produces 44% greater prediction displacement under 10% pixel deletion. On PASCAL3D+ with a 6D rotation decoder, the full differential improves mean deletion displacement by 14.1 degrees over the ambient coordinate sum and by 13.8 degrees over a decoder-invariant scalar. Results for a two-polarity tangent LayerCAM variant are mixed: it exceeds ambient-sum LayerCAM on circular regression but no difference is detected on quaternion pose. These results separate two failure sources, radial contamination and scalarization loss. The approach uses existing attribution methods with decoder-aware targets, although some variants also require changes to attribution aggregation. An invariant attribution can still miss inputs that drive the prediction, so invariance and deletion performance should each be checked.
items.title_ko: 디코더를 통한 귀인: 구조화된 출력을 위한 예측 공간 설명
items.summary_ko: 각도, 시선 방향, 회전을 예측하는 네트워크는 이러한 양을 직접 출력하지 않고, 고정된 디코더가 최종 예측으로 매핑하는 원시 좌표를 내보냅니다. 이 연구는 기존의 원시 좌표에 적용되던 귀인 방법을 대신하여, 디코더를 통한 예측 공간 귀인 방법을 제안하여 예측에 영향을 주지 않는 입력에 대한 오해를 줄입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 해석 가능성을 높이는 것은 모델의 신뢰성을 확보하는 데 중요하며, 특히 구조화된 출력에서 정확한 귀인 방법은 개발자가 모델의 작동 방식을 이해하는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: MoE--LoRA Methods for Multilingual Adaptation: A Systematic Empirical Study
items.body: Routed low-rank adapters offer a parameter-efficient means to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs) across tasks. Hence, it is assumed that they can also be used to improve the support of low-resource languages in LLMs, which currently serve English far better than the thousands of other languages spoken worldwide. However, this assumption has never been verified empirically under a shared multilingual evaluation protocol. We address exactly this gap by comparing eight low-rank adaptation (LoRA) methods on a frozen base model using 200 unique languages in more than 9{,}000 evaluation settings. Our results suggest that a reduced-scale search can identify viable configurations of LoRA methods but does not reliably predict their relative performance, as the top-ranking configuration is never best at scale. LoRA reliably improves language-model fit on translation data, consistently degrades reading comprehension, and benefits low-resource languages most. These findings suggest that LoRA methods should be regarded as targeted tools rather than general-purpose means for improving the multilingual capabilities of LLMs.
items.title_ko: MoE-LoRA 다국어 적응 방법: 체계적인 실증 연구
items.summary_ko: MoE(Mixture-of-Experts)와 LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation) 방법이 LLM의 다국어 성능 향상에 어떻게 기여하는지 체계적으로 연구합니다. 현재 영어 중심인 LLM의 저자원 언어 지원을 개선하기 위한 8가지 저랭크 어댑터 방식을 비교합니다.
items.why_ko: 다국어 AI 모델의 효율적인 개발은 글로벌 시장 확장에 필수적이며, MoE-LoRA와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 방법은 개발자들이 자원 제약 속에서 다국어 모델을 구축하는 데 유용합니다.

items.title: TextSphere: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation via Shared Hyperspherical Alignment and Uniformity
items.body: Recent advances in text-to-image generation have substantially improved image quality, particularly through diffusion-based methods that require multiple inference steps. In contrast, Sphere Encoder offers an efficient generative framework capable of producing images with fewer forward steps. However, extending it to free-form text is nontrivial, because its class-conditioned design lacks cross-modal alignment. To address this challenge, we propose TextSphere, an efficient text-to-image generative framework that extends Sphere Encoder with language conditioning and cross-modal alignment. We incorporate pretrained CLIP text embeddings through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to guide image generation while retaining the original spherical sampling mechanism. To bridge the cross-modal representation gap, we introduce a Spherical Semantic Alignment and Uniformity (SSAU) objective that jointly promotes semantic alignment and representation uniformity on the hypersphere. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, MS-COCO-2014, and Flickr30k demonstrate that TextSphere consistently reduces generation FID (gFID) over the text-conditioned baseline while achieving reconstruction FID (rFID) below 1.0. With only 4 and 6 sampling steps, TextSphere achieves lower gFID than the compared diffusion- and GAN-based models trained from scratch on CUB-200-2011 and MS-COCO-2014, respectively. We further observe that improved reconstruction fidelity does not necessarily yield better generation quality. In addition, we use Partial Least Squares Singular Value Decomposition (PLS-SVD) to analyze cross-modal alignment and modality gap, offering insight into the effectiveness of our approach.
items.title_ko: TextSphere: 공유 초구 정렬 및 균일성을 통한 효율적인 텍스트-이미지 생성
items.summary_ko: TextSphere는 여러 추론 단계가 필요한 기존 확산 기반 방법과 달리, 클래스 조건부 설계에서 교차 모달 정렬이 부족한 Sphere Encoder의 한계를 극복하여 효율적인 텍스트-이미지 생성을 가능하게 합니다. 공유 초구 정렬 및 균일성을 통해 자유 형식 텍스트 생성을 지원합니다.
items.why_ko: 효율적인 텍스트-이미지 생성 기술은 콘텐츠 제작 비용을 절감하고, 개발자들이 빠르고 다양한 시각 콘텐츠를 생성하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
items.body: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-policy baseline across multiple reasoning tasks. Overall, our results highlight how distributing samples across complementary policies can be a more effective use of sample budget than repeated i.i.d. sampling from a single policy at inference time.
items.title_ko: 추론 시 목표를 위한 계층화된 정책 학습
items.summary_ko: 추론 시 다수의 응답을 샘플링하고 집합적 유용성을 평가하여 대규모 언어 모델의 성능을 향상시키는 방법인 '계층화된 정책(stratified policies)'을 연구합니다. 이는 여러 학습된 정책에 샘플 예산을 할당하여 더 나은 성능을 얻는 방식입니다.
items.why_ko: 다양한 정책을 활용한 추론 최적화는 LLM의 성능과 신뢰성을 향상시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 개발자들이 더 견고한 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling
items.body: The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. Hence the constraints determine which team trajectories can be generated, and the demonstrations determine how likely each team trajectory is. Numerical results on two cooperative tasks show the effectiveness of the method, which generates cooperative team trajectories that satisfy the constraints and requires no retraining when agents join or leave the team. Finally, we implement the method on a multi-robot testbed.
items.title_ko: 장애물-유도 확산 샘플링을 통한 이기종 팀의 역량 구성
items.summary_ko: 이기종 팀의 에이전트들이 개별 역량을 넘어 협력하여 작업을 수행하는 방법을 연구합니다. 협력 시뮬레이션 데이터를 학습하여 팀 궤적을 생성하는 확산 모델을 제안하며, 특히 팀이 이전에 수행하지 않은 작업에 대한 시연 데이터가 없는 경우를 다룹니다.
items.why_ko: 이기종 에이전트 간의 협력 능력은 복잡한 문제 해결 및 다중 에이전트 시스템 개발에 필수적이며, 이는 로봇 공학 및 자율 시스템 분야에 중요합니다.

items.title: Mind the Gap: A Deployed Multi-Agent System for Documentation Maintenance
items.body: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.
items.title_ko: Mind the Gap: 문서 유지보수를 위한 배포된 멀티 에이전트 시스템
items.summary_ko: 기술 산업 전반에서 소프트웨어 기능 개발 속도가 빨라지는 반면, 고객 대면 문서는 그 속도를 따라가지 못하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 'Mind the Gap'이라는 멀티 에이전트 시스템을 소개합니다. 이 시스템은 문서가 뒤처진 부분을 식별하고 유지보수를 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트를 활용한 문서 자동화 및 유지보수는 소프트웨어 개발 및 운영 효율성을 크게 향상시키며, 개발자에게 실질적인 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: RSI-Prime: Training Models to Train Models
items.body: Enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously conduct training and improve target models is an important foundation for recursive self-improvement (RSI). As LLMs expand their role from being trained to conducting training, their model-training capability warrants dedicated study and systematic development. To this end, we construct RSI-Prime, a dataset for improving model-training capability, comprising 350 complete experimental trajectories across seven task categories. To help LLMs learn to make high-quality experimental decisions from training practice, we perform fine-grained decision identification and quality annotation, then apply decision-level loss masking to exclude supervision on low-quality behavior. Experiments with GLM-5.3 on PostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training, show that training on RSI-Prime yields a 31.95% relative improvement in overall performance over the original GLM-5.3, highlighting a path toward future RSI systems in which models autonomously sustain their own advancement.
items.title_ko: RSI-Prime: 모델 훈련을 위한 모델 훈련
items.summary_ko: LLM이 자율적으로 모델 훈련을 수행하고 목표 모델을 개선하는 '재귀적 자기 개선(RSI)'의 기반을 마련하기 위한 RSI-Prime 데이터셋을 구축합니다. 7개 작업 범주에 걸쳐 350개의 완전한 실험 궤적으로 구성되어 LLM이 모델 훈련 능력을 학습하도록 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 스스로 학습하고 개선하는 능력은 미래 AI 시스템의 핵심 요소이며, RSI-Prime은 이러한 자기 개선 메커니즘을 연구하고 개발하는 데 중요한 도구가 될 것입니다.

items.title: Correcting Flows with Marginal Matching
items.body: Flow matching models, ODE-based generative models, generate samples by gradually morphing a simple source distribution into a target distribution. However, these models still face challenges in optimally balancing computational efficiency with generation fidelity. While predictor-corrector schemes have been proven to help address this issue in diffusion models effectively, their application to flow matching models remains under-explored. In this work we present a novel training-based predictor-corrector framework for flow matching, which exploits the fact that the ODE can be easily reversed. Our key idea, termed Marginal Matching, is to correct samples at a particular time step in the forward ODE towards a matching marginal distribution of the backward ODE. This scheme proves to reduce a bound on the distance between the data distribution and the learned distribution, motivating two different implementations for the correction function. We show that our proposed method improves sample quality on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64, with minimal overhead in computation time.
items.title_ko: 마진 매칭을 통한 흐름 보정
items.summary_ko: ODE 기반 생성 모델인 흐름 매칭(Flow Matching) 모델의 계산 효율성과 생성 충실도 간의 균형 문제를 해결하기 위해 새로운 훈련 기반 예측기-보정기 방식을 제안합니다. 이 방식은 중요도 샘플링과 MCMC를 사용하여 샘플을 보정하고 리플레이 버퍼를 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성 모델의 효율성과 품질을 동시에 개선하는 방법은 실제 애플리케이션에서 AI 모델의 성능을 극대화하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: A Neural Envelope Method for Rapid Gradient-based Optimum Takeoff Trajectory Design
items.body: Urban air mobility arises to mitigate ground traffic congestion. Multidisciplinary analysis and optimization (MDAO) has been introduced to reduce the energy consumption, thereby expanding aircraft performance. Surrogate-based MDAO lowers the cost of optimization, but multimodality disrupts global optimum search for both simulation-based and surrogate-based optimizations. Convex envelopes convert multimodal spaces into unimodal spaces, permitting efficient convex optimization; however, convexifying a design space may produce infeasible "optimal" designs due to complex design constraints. To address these challenges, this work proposes the coupling of a physics-constrained generative adversarial networks (physicsGAN) and neural envelope to transform original, constrained, non-convex optimizations into unconstrained, convex optimizations. Specifically, the physicsGAN discovers a feasible design space where all design candidates inherently satisfy all constraints, by penalizing surrogate-predicted constraint violations during training. Moreover, the neural envelope constructs a neural network-based convex envelope for the transformed objective function within the physicsGAN-discovered feasible space. Note that the neural envelope only needs to deal with objective function since constraints are inherently satisfied in the feasible space. The neural envelope is demonstrated on takeoff trajectory optimizations of the Airbus A3 Vahana eVTOL aircraft. Results show that neural envelopes achieve a 99.91% mean accuracy within a flight-condition space compared with reference convex envelopes. Neural-envelope-enabled optimizations achieve 99.84% accuracy on the global optimum design, costing only 0.04 seconds on average. The neural envelope accelerates the trajectory optimization by 53 and 162 times on average compared to the physicsGAN-enabled gradient-based and global optimizations, respectively.
items.title_ko: 신경망 엔벨롭 방법: 경사 기반 최적 이륙 궤적 설계 가속화
items.summary_ko: 도시 항공 모빌리티(UAM)의 에너지 소비를 줄이기 위해 다분야 분석 및 최적화(MDAO)가 도입됩니다. 이 연구는 신경망 엔벨롭 방법을 통해 다중 모드 공간을 단일 모드 공간으로 변환하여 효율적인 볼록 최적화를 가능하게 함으로써, 경사 기반 최적 이륙 궤적 설계를 가속화합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율 비행체 및 로봇 시스템의 최적화된 궤적 설계는 에너지 효율성과 안전성을 높이는 데 필수적이며, 이는 AI 기반 제어 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Where Should Physics Enter? Information, Identifiability and Calibration in Probabilistic Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting
items.body: Advection-diffusion priors are a common way to make neural sea surface temperature (SST) forecasts physics-informed. We test where such a prior must enter a heteroscedastic ConvLSTM to help, using daily NOAA OISST v2.1 for the Bay of Bengal (1982-2024) and a synthetic benchmark on the same grid with known currents of controlled strength. (i) On real data, a soft advection-diffusion residual with a learned velocity gives no reliable benefit (lead-15 CRPS -0.007 degrees C, 95% interval [-0.022, +0.008]); a plain temporal-smoothness penalty matches it, and equivalence within 3% is not established either. (ii) Learned velocities do not recover the currents, whether placed in the loss, in an explicit transport step, or in a transport step without neural correction: they correlate with the reference no better than a shuffled-date null, even on synthetic data where knowing the currents would improve day-15 forecasts by 16-23%. (iii) Supplied currents help on synthetic data, but mostly as information: giving them to the network as input channels, without transport, recovers 92% of the transport design's lead-5 gain, and a frozen-current numerical forecast does as well as either. (iv) With GLORYS12 reanalysis currents on real data, the transport design is 6% and 4% worse at leads 1 and 5; reanalysis advection explains essentially none of the daily OISST change (correlation 0.02), and frozen-current transport is worse than persistence. (v) The defect that matters is lead-dependent miscalibration shared by every model. One variance multiplier per lead, fitted on validation data, brings 90% coverage to 0.85-0.91 at all leads and lowers day-1 CRPS by 13-21%; fine-tuning on 15-day rollouts fixes long-lead coverage but costs short-lead skill. This version withdraws an earlier claim of an 81% CRPS reduction that came from an uncontrolled comparison.
items.title_ko: 물리학은 어디에 개입해야 하는가? 확률론적 해수면 온도 예측의 정보, 식별성, 보정
items.summary_ko: 신경 해수면 온도(SST) 예측에 물리학 정보(advection-diffusion priors)를 통합하는 최적의 지점을 탐구합니다. 실제 데이터와 합성 벤치마크를 사용하여 이종분산 ConvLSTM 모델에 물리학 지식이 어떻게 영향을 미치는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델에 물리 법칙을 통합하는 방식은 과학적 예측 모델의 정확성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 중요하며, 이는 기후 모델링 등 복잡한 과학 문제 해결에 기여합니다.

items.title: The Illusion of Grounding: Do Vision-Language Models Weigh Retrieved Text and Images Like an Ideal Observer?
items.body: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.
items.title_ko: 접지 환상: 비전-언어 모델은 이상적인 관찰자처럼 텍스트와 이미지 정보를 가중하는가?
items.summary_ko: 검색 증강 비전-언어 모델(VLM)이 검색된 텍스트와 이미지 정보를 이상적인 관찰자처럼 가중하여 답변하는지 'GIB-200K' 데이터셋으로 평가합니다. 텍스트 노이즈, 시각적 모호성, 교차 모달 충돌 등 통제된 스트레스 조건에서 모델의 취약점을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: VLM의 정보 해석 능력과 신뢰성은 매우 중요하며, 다양한 정보원과의 상호작용 방식에 대한 이해는 더욱 견고하고 정확한 VLM 개발에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Which Past Matters? Training History and Multi-Forecast Horizon in Equity Transformers
items.body: More historical data can improve estimation while introducing relationships that transfer poorly to current market conditions. We therefore examine how training quantity and historical selection interact with forecast horizon in intraday equity prediction. We deploy twelve configurations which combine four sampling and validation policies with 6, 12 and 24 month training quantities under a fixed cross-sectional Transformer and feature set. A monthly walk-forward experiment produces 264 refits and eight cumulative return forecasts from 5 to 120 minutes. Evaluation covers January 2025 through 20 October 2026 and uses cross-sectional Spearman information coefficients against future five-factor residual returns. Six-month recency sampling leads individual models at 5-15 minutes, while multi recency configurations lead at 20-30 minutes and uniform configurations at 60-120 minutes. Increasing training quantity does not uniformly improve accuracy while an equal-weight ensemble of all twelve models exceeds every individual mean at 15, 20 and 25 minutes, but not at the remaining horizons. These findings support evaluating historical selection jointly with forecast horizon without identifying a universal policy or a causal benefit from recency.
items.title_ko: 어떤 과거가 중요한가? 주식 트랜스포머의 훈련 이력과 다중 예측 기간
items.summary_ko: 주식 시장 예측에서 과거 데이터의 양과 선택이 예측 기간과 어떻게 상호작용하는지 조사합니다. 더 많은 과거 데이터가 추정치를 개선할 수 있지만, 현재 시장 조건에 잘 맞지 않는 관계를 도입할 수 있다는 점을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: 금융 시장 예측에서 데이터 선택과 모델 훈련 기간의 최적화는 투자 전략 및 위험 관리에 직접적인 영향을 미치며, AI 기반 금융 모델 개발에 중요한 실무 지식을 제공합니다.

items.title: Get Hint-Augmented GRPO Done Right Through Activation Steering
items.body: GRPO has become the dominant reinforcement learning method for eliciting reasoning capability in LLMs using verifiable rewards. However, it suffers from a fundamental failure mode: when a training question exceeds the base model's current capability, all generated responses fail and receive zero reward, yielding no gradient signal and stalling further capability expansion. An emerging class of GRPO extensions, termed Hint-Augmented GRPO (HA-GRPO), adds a "hint" to the context to reduce the difficulty of the question, thereby producing a usable gradient signal. Nevertheless, existing HA-GRPO methods share a key issue: no hint is available at inference time to append to the question, creating a training-inference context mismatch that leads to inconsistent performance gains. In this work, we reinterpret the function of hinting -- not as reducing question difficulty, but as steering model behavior -- and propose ASH (Activation Steering for Hinting), a novel HA-GRPO method built on this view. During training, the model is presented with both hinted and plain questions, while a trainable steering vector is optimized to widen the margins between the model's generation probabilities for responses to the hinted version relative to the plain version, thereby capturing the question-agnostic component of the behavioral shift induced by the hint. During inference, the trained steering vector is directly injected into the model's activation, reproducing the hint-conditioned behavior without requiring any hint in the context. Experiments with four LLMs (Qwen3-1.7B/4B-Base, Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct) show that ASH consistently improves pass@$k$ on competition-level mathematics benchmarks (AMC, OlympiadBench, AIME24, AIME25) and out-of-distribution benchmarks (Minerva, GPQA-Diamond). Notably, it improves average pass@8 of Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-4B-Base by \textbf{2.60}\% and \textbf{2.21}\%.
items.title_ko: 활성화 조향을 통해 힌트 증강 GRPO를 올바르게 구현하기
items.summary_ko: GRPO(Ground-truth Reinforcement Policy Optimization)는 LLM에서 검증 가능한 보상을 사용하여 추론 능력을 이끌어내는 지배적인 강화 학습 방법입니다. 이 연구는 기본 모델의 능력을 초과하는 질문에 대한 GRPO의 한계를 극복하기 위해 '힌트 증강 GRPO(HA-GRPO)'에 활성화 조향(Activation Steering) 기법을 적용하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 추론 능력을 향상시키기 위한 GRPO 기법의 개선은 복잡한 문제 해결 능력을 가진 AI 에이전트 개발에 중요하며, 개발자에게 새로운 훈련 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: Dynamic Task Allocation with Dialogue
items.body: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings.
