Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.
items.title_ko: 대화를 통한 동적 작업 할당
items.summary_ko: 효과적인 다중 에이전트 협업을 위해 목표와 책임이 변화함에 따라 에이전트가 작업 할당을 조정해야 하는 동적 작업 할당 방법을 연구합니다. 기존 프레임워크의 한계를 극복하고, 에이전트 간의 대화를 통해 작업 할당의 유연성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 동적 작업 할당은 복잡하고 변화무쌍한 환경에서 다중 에이전트 시스템의 효율성과 적응성을 높이는 데 필수적이며, 이는 자율 협력 시스템 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D
items.body: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot. Training on the model's own rollouts beat one-step training at 368 steps on all ten held-out episodes (registered), although one-step training was better one step ahead. One-step checks therefore misjudge design choices: pruning 30% of the weights kept 90% of the model's skill one step ahead and 39% at 2 s. Ensemble disagreement ranked rollout error well (Spearman +0.90 at 100 steps), yet covered 4.6% of outcomes at one sigma, against 68% for a calibrated estimate, as each network's own variance collapses under the implemented loss. Two checks that need no recorded future ranked some pools of simulators well, but neither was shown better than 8-step error in a primary test. At the robot level, accuracy has not predicted walking: all 18 fine-tuned copies we tested predicted better than the released model one and eight steps ahead, yet 13 gave failing policies, and registered tests of whether any check ranks simulators by their policies were not settled. In a secondary test, running the authors' policy inside each simulator ranked them well. We also report nine of our own claims that we withdrew. Scope: one robot, one gait, simulated data, no hardware.
items.title_ko: 사족 보행 로봇을 위한 학습된 시뮬레이터 감사: ANYmal D 로봇 세계 모델
items.summary_ko: 사족 보행 로봇 ANYmal D의 '로봇 세계 모델(RWM)' 동역학 모델과 후속 모델인 RWM-U의 불확실성 추정치를 엔드 투 엔드로 감사합니다. 학습된 시뮬레이터의 신뢰성을 검증하고, 실제 정책이 시뮬레이터를 사용하는 방식과 학습 방식 간의 불일치를 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 시뮬레이터의 정확성과 신뢰성 검증은 실제 로봇 제어 시스템 개발에 필수적이며, 이는 AI 기반 로봇 공학의 안전하고 효율적인 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
items.body: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person. Nunchi outperforms the strongest existing method by 4.8 percentage points. On SORBET, conversational cues help whereas additional visual cues do not, and the gains hold across three VLMs, with automatic transcripts, and on two existing datasets.
items.title_ko: Nunchi: 다자간 대화에서 눈이 귀를 돕다
items.summary_ko: 다자간 대화에서 누가 누구를 보는지 식별하는 것이 중요하지만, 시선 기하학만으로는 모호해질 수 있습니다. SORBET이라는 새로운 벤치마크는 동기화된 음성, 대본 및 시선 정보를 포함하여 대화에서 시선 해석을 돕는 단서를 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 다자간 상호작용에서 AI가 인간의 행동(시선, 음성)을 이해하는 능력은 사회적 로봇 및 대화형 AI 시스템 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: Large-scale Neuron Community Discovery Reveals Neuron-Sparse Behaviors in Language Models
items.body: What reusable units of computation can we discover within a language model's neurons? Prior work has shown that individual forward passes can often be sparsified post-hoc to small groups of neurons, but it has been unclear whether these groups form coherent computational entities reused across inputs. We introduce neuron community discovery, an unsupervised method for finding neuron groups that recur across prompts and are causally necessary and sufficient, within the layers they span, for common computations. The method combines gradient-based attribution, a graph connecting neurons that are repeatedly attributed together, and community detection. Applied to Llama-3.1-8B using ten million prompts, it discovers thousands of candidate communities. We evaluate them on held-out prompts through three causal tests: community necessity, sufficiency within a layer subset, and layer necessity. These tests identify groups whose removal disrupts predictions and whose retention preserves predictions despite ablating the remaining MLP neurons in the tested layers. Discovered communities support functions like grammatical agreement, token-probability calibration, fixed phrases, in-context copying, addition, and multiplication. With communities capped at 128 neurons across all layers, 10.3% of held-out prompts have at least one layer's contribution explained on a neuron-sparse basis. Coverage remains 8.7% when requiring at least four layers and 3.3% when requiring at least twelve. These results show that small groups of existing neurons can provide reusable computational components across prompts, and that such groups can be discovered at scale.
items.title_ko: 대규모 뉴런 커뮤니티 발견: 언어 모델의 뉴런 희소 행동
items.summary_ko: 언어 모델 뉴런 내에서 재사용 가능한 계산 단위인 '뉴런 커뮤니티'를 발견하는 비지도 학습 방법을 소개합니다. 이 방법은 프롬프트에 걸쳐 반복되고, 특정 레이어 내에서 공통적인 행동에 인과적으로 필요충분한 뉴런 그룹을 찾습니다.
items.why_ko: 언어 모델의 내부 작동 방식을 이해하는 것은 모델의 효율성을 높이고, 특정 기능을 제어하는 데 중요합니다. 이는 모델 해석 가능성 연구에 기여합니다.

items.title: Event-Based Dynamic Lip Region Estimation During Speech
items.body:
Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. These include automatic lip reading, audiovisual speech analysis, and human-robot interaction, particularly in challenging environments characterized by low illumination or high dynamic range. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection, however, mostly operate on a cropped region of interest (ROI), by hand or by the dataset, and no event-based method supplies that ROI as a spatial region; existing event-based face analysis gives the mouth as landmarks, which presents a mismatch between application and localization. The present work predicts a dense heatmap over the lip region from the full event "frame". Events are encoded as a polarity-separated voxel grid and processed at every location by a two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) with learned, log-space bounded time constants acting on the real elapsed time of each bin: a stateless fast pathway and a stateful slow pathway, utilised for refining and anchoring the prediction. The model reaches 69.5% on lips on four unseen speakers and switches target only 2.1 times per second, against 8.9 and 11.0 for convolutional baselines with
more parameters. Adding a spatial encoder improves precision but fails on a new face scale. On a real event sensor, trained only on simulated events, the proposed model reaches 58.0% on lips against 43.2% for the CNN, with fewer than half its target switches.
items.title_ko: 이벤트 기반 동적 입술 영역 추정: 발화 중 변화 포착
items.summary_ko: 이벤트 카메라의 높은 시간 해상도와 낮은 전력 소비를 활용하여 발화 중 동적인 입술 영역을 추정하는 방법을 제안합니다. 이는 저조도 또는 높은 동적 범위와 같은 어려운 환경에서도 자동 입술 판독, 시청각 음성 분석 등에 적용될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 음성 인식 및 비언어적 의사소통 연구에서 이벤트 카메라를 활용한 동적 입술 영역 추정은 AI가 인간의 언어 정보를 더욱 정확하게 포착하도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Natural Language Programming: Rethinking Language, Memory, and Cognition in the Era of Generative AI
items.body:
Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows.
This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures.
Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence.
Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.
items.body_ko:
생성형 인공지능은 계산 시스템에서 자연어의 역할을 변화시키고 있습니다. 고전적인 자연어 처리(NLP)에서 언어는 계산의 대상으로 다루어졌습니다. 즉, 분석, 분류, 번역 또는 생성해야 할 대상이었습니다. 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)은 이러한 관점에 도전하며, 자연어가 인간이 추론을 구성하고, 문제 해결을 조율하며, 하이브리드 인간/AI 워크플로우를 조절하는 실행 가능한 인지 매체로서 기능할 수 있도록 합니다.
본 논문은 자연어 프로그래밍(NLPg)을 전통적인 NLP의 이론적 및 인식론적 확장으로 소개합니다. NLPg는 단순히 언어 이해에만 초점을 맞추는 대신, 프롬프트를 목표, 제약, 가정, 검증 기준 및 중간 추론 상태를 외면화하는 동적 인지 인공물로 개념화합니다. 따라서 프롬프팅은 단순한 기술적 상호작용 기법이 아니라, 분산된 인간/AI 메모리 아키텍처 내에서 작동하는 대화적 인지 프로그래밍의 한 형태입니다.
분산 인지, 확장된 마음, 메타인지, 대화적 학습 이론을 바탕으로, 본 논문은 프롬프트와 대화 상태가 추론의 연속성과 반성적 조절을 지원하는 임시적인 외부 기억 구조로 기능하는 방식을 설명하는 대화적 작업 기억(Dialogic Working Memory) 개념을 제안합니다. 우리는 또한 기존 메모리 아키텍처(BTMA, SKGE, RMR)를 이 프레임워크에 매핑하여, 에피소드, 의미론적, 메타인지적 계층이 장기적인 대화적 일관성을 어떻게 지원하는지 설명합니다.
마지막으로, 계산 언어학 및 AI/매개 지식 시스템에 대한 시사점을 논의하며, 자연어가 통신 매체, 실행 가능한 사양, 인지 비계, 분산 메모리 아키텍처로서 동시에 작동하는 후기 상징적 및 후기 인터페이스 패러다임을 제안합니다.
items.title_ko: 자연어 프로그래밍: 생성 AI 시대의 언어, 기억, 인지 재고
items.summary_ko: 생성 AI는 자연어가 컴퓨팅 시스템에서 수행하는 역할을 변화시키고 있습니다. 기존 NLP가 언어를 계산의 대상으로 여겼던 것과 달리, 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)은 자연어를 실행 가능한 인지 매체로 활용하여 추론을 구조화하고 문제 해결을 조율하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 자연어 프로그래밍은 개발자들이 AI와 상호작용하고 복잡한 문제를 해결하는 방식을 혁신할 잠재력을 가지며, 이는 AI 기반 시스템 설계에 대한 새로운 사고방식을 요구합니다.

items.title: Hidden-State Similarity Predicts Re-Elicitation After Inoculation Prompting
items.body: Fine-tuning on narrow harmful tasks can cause emergent misalignment, where models generalize harmful behavior beyond the training distribution. Inoculation prompting can reduce this effect by explicitly eliciting the undesired behavior during training, but recent work shows that the behavior can reappear when evaluation prompts contain cues from the training context. We study what makes such prompts effective triggers. We find that, surprisingly, textual similarity to the inoculation prompt is an incomplete predictor. Instead, prompts are more likely to re-elicit suppressed behavior when they induce activation states similar to those produced by the inoculation context. These findings advance our understanding of how inoculation prompting modulates conditional misalignment, and suggest that activation space analysis can help identify when suppressed behaviors remain accessible under eval-time prompts.
items.title_ko: 히든 스테이트 유사성, 예방 프롬프팅 후 재유도 예측
items.summary_ko: 좁은 유해 작업에 대한 미세 조정이 모델이 훈련 분포를 넘어 유해한 행동을 일반화하는 '새로운 오정렬'을 일으킬 수 있음을 연구합니다. 예방 프롬프팅이 이 효과를 줄일 수 있지만, 훈련 맥락의 단서가 포함된 평가 프롬프트에서 유해 행동이 다시 나타날 수 있음을 발견합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 안전성 연구에서 예방 프롬프팅의 효과와 한계를 이해하는 것은 모델의 견고성을 높이고, 원치 않는 행동을 예측 및 방지하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: What's in a Tree ? Hierarchical $n$-gram models as controlled approximators of language
items.body: Hierarchical models have been proposed as synthetic settings for studying language. However, their relevance to realistic language corpora remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce tree-grams, autoregressive generative $n$-gram models that build the conditional probability tensor $p(x_n \mid x_{1:n-1})$ through a hierarchical composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors. $n$ controls the maximal context window, whereas a rank hyperparameter $d$ controls model capacity, yielding an interpretable and systematically scalable family of approximators of language. We show how tree-grams outperform existing $n$-gram baselines, while remaining competitive with deep transformer-based language models. We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by using tree-grams as generative models. In particular, we show that hyperparameter transfer under $μ$P can be made more robust when narrower models are tuned on simpler data, generated by tree-grams with moderate $n$ and $d$. In addition, we show that entropy and effective range of correlations control performance gap after fine-tuning. This is because tree-grams allow us to explicitly control horizon and capacity. When allowed to route across candidate topologies, we observe emergent sparsity in tree-grams. Such concentrated routing permits pruning upto 95\% of topologies without significant change in performance.
items.title_ko: 트리 안의 무엇? 언어의 제어된 근사치로서의 계층적 n-그램 모델
items.summary_ko: 계층적 모델이 언어 연구를 위한 합성 설정으로 제안되었지만, 실제 언어 코퍼스와의 관련성은 충분히 탐구되지 않았습니다. 이 연구는 계층적 n-그램 모델인 '트리-그램'을 소개하며, 조건부 확률 텐서를 계층적 구성으로 구축하여 언어를 제어된 방식으로 근사화합니다.
items.why_ko: 언어의 구조적 복잡성을 모델링하는 새로운 접근 방식은 LLM의 언어 이해 및 생성 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: BugGen 2.0: Rethinking the Roles of LLMs for Scalable RTL Bug Synthesis
items.body: AI-assisted RTL localization and debugging need ground-truth bug datasets with known locations and observable failures, while testbench grading uses injected bugs to measure detection capability. Creating such datasets at scale remains a major EDA challenge. BugGen 1.0 shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate context-aware RTL mutations. Still, it relies on the model for both choosing where to mutate and generating the edit, which increases inference costs and can lead to invalid choices. BugGen 2.0 changes this division of labor. Deterministic algorithms handle structural analysis, target selection, and validation, while the LLM focuses on localized semantic rewriting. Across four OpenTitan IP blocks and FabScalar with three LLMs, BugGen 2.0 reaches every requested quota of compilable bug scenarios that cause at least two test failures, with 14-16 of 16 configured mutation types represented. In completed same-model comparisons, it reduces token use by 6.8x-15.4x relative to BugGen 1.0 and 1.5x-7.9x relative to Firefly. BugGen 2.0 also expands the dataset without simulating every new bug. After finding accepted scenarios with observable failures, it generates alternative mutations at the same locations, simulates only a subset, and estimates acceptance for the rest. This skips 63.6% of AES and 33.9% of FabScalar variant simulations. Full simulation finds that 77.7% of AES variants and 95.2% of FabScalar variants are accepted, with a 1.09% estimation error on the directly comparable FabScalar set. These results show that focusing LLMs on semantic rewriting lowers inference and simulation cost while improving consistency across models and designs.
items.title_ko: BugGen 2.0: 확장 가능한 RTL 버그 합성을 위한 LLM 역할 재고
items.summary_ko: BugGen 1.0이 LLM이 상황 인지 RTL(Register-Transfer Level) 변이를 생성할 수 있음을 보여주었지만, 변이 위치 선택과 편집 생성 모두를 모델에 의존하여 추론 비용을 증가시키고 잘못된 선택을 초래할 수 있었습니다. BugGen 2.0은 이러한 문제를 해결하기 위해 LLM의 역할을 재고합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 버그 합성 기술은 반도체 설계 검증 및 디버깅의 효율성을 높여 개발 시간을 단축하고, 더욱 안정적인 하드웨어 설계를 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Learning to Undo: Transfer Reinforcement Learning under State Space Transformations
items.body: Transfer learning in reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong empirical success. In this work, we take a more principled perspective by studying when and how transferring knowledge between MDPs (a source and a target) can be provably beneficial. Specifically, we consider the case where there exists an undo map such that applying this map to the target's state space recovers the source exactly. We propose an algorithm that learns this map by matching state feature statistics gathered from both MDPs, and then uses it to transfer the source policy to the target. We theoretically justify the algorithm by analyzing the setting when the undo map is linear and the source is linearly-$Q^\star$ realizable, where our approach has strictly better sample complexity than tabula rasa RL in the target MDP. Empirically, we demonstrate that these benefits extend beyond this regime: on challenging continuous control tasks and Atari games, our method achieves significantly better sample efficiency. Overall, our results highlight how shared structure between tasks can be leveraged for efficient transfer of policies across environments.
items.title_ko: 되돌리기 학습: 상태 공간 변환 하의 전이 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 강화 학습(RL)에서 전이 학습(Transfer Learning)은 경험적으로 성공을 보였지만, MDP(Markov Decision Process) 간 지식 전이가 언제 어떻게 유익할 수 있는지 원칙적인 관점에서 연구합니다. 특히, 목표 상태 공간에 되돌리기 맵을 적용하여 소스 상태를 복구하는 경우를 고려합니다.
items.why_ko: 전이 강화 학습은 새로운 환경에 AI 에이전트를 빠르게 적응시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 실제 로봇 공학 및 자율 시스템 개발에 유용합니다.

items.title: Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
items.body: Science advances from frontier to frontier as discoveries reshape what is known and create the basis for further discovery. We present Colombo, a self-organizing AI researcher that drives this renewal, first instantiated in oracle-based optimization. Here, the central question is how efficiently a problem class can be solved through a prescribed information interface and what costs no admissible algorithm can avoid. The gap between achievable guarantees and unavoidable limits defines the frontier recorded in its Complexity Atlas, a living map of frontier settings and the current state of knowledge. Self-Organization turns unresolved gaps into adaptive research programmes, coordinating conjecture formation, mathematical investigation, and replanning as evidence accumulates. Adversarial Co-Ascent develops algorithms and hard families through reciprocal challenge, exposing mechanisms of information use and concealment that guide stronger methods and proofs of unavoidable costs. Independent review and Lean-based formal certification check mathematical claims, while the Long-Term Memory carries supported findings and research experience across settings. To date, Colombo has established optimal or near-optimal rates for more than fifty settings in the Atlas. Colombo thus takes a concrete step toward Autopoietic Science: a scientific process whose validated advances regenerate the conditions of its own progress, continually reshaping how inquiry is organized and what it can discover.
items.title_ko: 콜롬보: 오라클 기반 최적화를 위한 최전선 간 자동 연구 시스템
items.summary_ko: 콜롬보는 오라클 기반 최적화 분야에서 자율적으로 연구를 수행하고 새로운 발견을 이끄는 '자기 조직화 AI 연구자' 시스템입니다. 주어진 정보 인터페이스를 통해 문제 클래스를 얼마나 효율적으로 해결할 수 있는지, 그리고 어떤 비용을 피할 수 없는지에 대한 질문을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 자율 과학 연구 시스템은 새로운 지식 발견을 가속화하고, 복잡한 과학 문제를 해결하는 데 혁신적인 접근 방식을 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Pareto-Informed Smart "Predict, then Optimize" for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Problems
items.body: Many real-world planning applications, from logistics, routing to resource allocation, give rise to optimization problems that need to balance multiple, conflicting objectives. While machine learning is often used to predict the unknown parameters or costs of these problems, standard models trained on prediction accuracy can lead to suboptimal plans. Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) addresses this by integrating the downstream optimization task into the training objective. However, existing DFL methods for multi-objective problems rely on simple scalarization, which fails to capture the rich trade-offs of the Pareto Frontier. To address this gap, we propose a Pareto-aware extension to single-objective Smart "Predict, then Optimize" (SPO+) for multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems. Our loss function leverages the true Pareto Frontier, forming a target decision that aligns with a sampled preference vector, and minimizes regret against this target. Experiments on multi-objective shortest path and multi-objective knapsack problems show that our approach outperforms traditional two-stage Mean Squared Error (MSE) baselines. It also surpasses scalarization-based SPO+ approaches.
items.title_ko: 다중 목표 조합 문제 해결을 위한 파레토 정보 기반 스마트 "예측 후 최적화" 전략
items.summary_ko: 물류, 라우팅, 자원 할당 등 여러 상충하는 목표를 가진 실제 최적화 문제 해결을 위해 파레토 정보를 활용한 스마트 "예측 후 최적화"(Predict, then Optimize) 전략을 제안합니다. 이는 예측 정확도에만 초점을 맞춘 기존 머신러닝 모델의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 목표 최적화는 실제 산업 문제에서 자주 발생하며, AI 기반의 효율적인 해결책은 의사결정 프로세스를 개선하고 비즈니스 가치를 창출하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
items.body: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. We show that CriteriaBank pretraining improves cross-domain transfer, particularly in the low-data regime, while matching a strong direct-finetuning control at full data. On a single H100, VFM-4B evaluates 1,000 criteria against a 4K-token context in under 2s at <11 GB VRAM, making it suitable for runtime verification.
items.title_ko: 에이전트 거버넌스를 위한 다중 자연어 기준의 런타임 검증
items.summary_ko: AI 에이전트가 수백 가지 자연어 기준에 의해 통제되지만, 기존 검증기는 대규모 기준에 대한 에이전트 출력을 효율적으로 평가하기 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 공유 컨텍스트와 목표 텍스트를 인코딩하고, N개의 자연어 기준을 병렬로 평가하는 트리-어텐션 검증기(VFM)를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 행동이 윤리적, 정책적 기준을 준수하는지 런타임에 검증하는 기술은 AI 시스템의 신뢰성과 안전성을 보장하는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: Amortizing Tempered Sampling with Corrected Self-Training
items.body: Learning a neural sampler can reduce the cost of repeated sampling from an un-normalized distribution, but obtaining good training data remains difficult. We develop a corrected self-training scheme across a sequence of tempered targets, making use of importance sampling and Markov chain Monte Carlo to correct the samples and replay buffers to store them. We introduce Sequential Score Sampler (SSS) as a particular case. In SSS, the proposal is a score-based diffusion trained by regression on energy gradients; and the samples are corrected by importance weights on the path space. After training, samples can be collected directly from the model, from its importance-corrected proposals, or from the final-temperature buffer. The method amortizes repeated sampling by encoding the global structure of the target in the model. SSS achieves competitive sampling accuracy across the benchmarks and, on several targets, uses shorter runtimes with fewer energy evaluations than competing samplers.
items.title_ko: 수정된 자기 훈련을 통한 완화된 샘플링 상각
items.summary_ko: 비정규화된 분포에서 반복적인 샘플링 비용을 줄이기 위해 신경망 샘플러를 학습하는 방법을 개발합니다. 중요도 샘플링 및 MCMC(Markov chain Monte Carlo)를 사용하여 샘플을 보정하고, 리플레이 버퍼를 사용하여 저장하는 수정된 자기 훈련 방식을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 샘플링 효율성 개선은 베이즈 추론, 생성 모델 등 AI 분야 전반의 계산 비용을 줄이고 모델 성능을 향상시키는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
items.body: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. This loop has shown promise, yet practitioners face a puzzle: methods trade wins across papers, and evolution often fails to bootstrap on certain tasks. We trace this puzzle to the Resolution Hypothesis: agent evolution stalls not because methods fail to propose better artifacts, but because noisy evaluations cannot reliably identify them. Across seven evolution methods and six models (over 10M LLM calls), we find support for the hypothesis at both levels where evaluation scores are used. At the candidate level (choosing artifacts), helpful candidate artifacts exist, but selection is no better than random at telling them from harmful ones, so errors accumulate across rounds. At the method level (ranking methods), typical margins of a few percentage points are smaller than the difference between two independent runs of the same method, so published rankings often rest on luck. Together, these findings indicate that agent evolution is often bottlenecked by reliably identifying improvements. This calls for a shift in how we develop and evaluate self-improving agents, from designing ever more candidate improvement systems to making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
items.title_ko: 해상도 가설: 에이전트 진화의 핵심은 개선 사항 식별
items.summary_ko: 에이전트 진화가 더 나은 아티팩트를 제안하는 데 실패해서가 아니라, 노이즈가 많은 평가가 개선 사항을 신뢰할 수 있게 식별하지 못하기 때문에 정체된다는 '해상도 가설'을 제시합니다. 이는 에이전트 진화 방법론의 핵심 문제를 지적합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 효율적인 진화 및 개선을 위해서는 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있는 평가 메커니즘이 필수적이며, 이는 개발자들이 AI 시스템의 학습 과정을 최적화하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Values Shape What Self-Improving Coding Agents Build
items.body: Self-improving agents are typically optimized for the results they produce, with less attention to how they produce them. Their instructions give designers limited ways to shape how they work, especially when the task is open-ended. This paper studies whether a short value statement in an agent's persistent instruction file changes not only how well the agent performs but also what it builds. Four higher-order value types in Schwartz's theory of basic human values were evaluated: openness to change, conservation, self-enhancement, and self-transcendence. Across diverse coding tasks, the values were held fixed within each run over multiple iterations of self-improvement. Three findings emerged: (1) Values matter for performance across a diverse set of tasks. The openness values increase performance on held-out data, whereas the opposite conservation values result in scores below those of an agent given no values. (2) Values change what agents build, producing solution algorithms that differ in size, complexity and approach. (3) Human oversight is still needed for designing values. Allowing the agent to revise its own values narrows the differences between sets of values, and values distilled from the AI literature provide no detectable gain over having no values. Properly designed values can thus influence what a self-improving coding agent builds and, where the task permits, how well it performs.
items.title_ko: 자기 개선 코딩 에이전트가 구축하는 것을 형성하는 가치
items.summary_ko: 자기 개선 에이전트는 일반적으로 결과물에 최적화되지만, 이 연구는 에이전트의 영구 명령어 파일에 짧은 가치 명세서를 추가함으로써 에이전트의 성능뿐 아니라 무엇을 구축하는지에도 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 보여줍니다. Schwartz의 기본 인간 가치 이론의 네 가지 고차 가치 유형을 평가했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 행동을 제어하고 가치에 기반한 결과물을 생성하도록 유도하는 것은 AI의 책임감 있는 개발 및 윤리적 활용에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study
items.body: Efficient control of underfloor heating (UFH) systems coupled with heat pumps (HPs) is challenging due to the high thermal inertia of buildings and the slow dynamic response of UFH systems. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a data-driven control approach capable of simultaneously optimizing energy consumption and thermal comfort. However, the application of DRL-based controllers in occupied buildings under real operating conditions remains limited. This work presents and end-to-end case study (development, evaluation, and real-world deployment) of a DRL-based controller for an integrated UFH-HP system. First, a simulation-based pilot study was conducted to assess different DRL algorithms, control strategies, and configurations. Subsequently, a digital twin of a real residential building was developed and used to train DRL agents under simulated operating conditions. The best-performing agent was then deployed in the physical building without additional online fine-tuning. The results show that the controller successfully maintained indoor temperatures within the prescribed comfort limits while dynamically adjusting the HP supply temperature and UFH valve positions. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of deploying DRL controllers in occupied buildings and highlight their robustness and the practical challenges associated with transferring control policies from digital environments to real heating systems.
items.title_ko: 히트 펌프 및 바닥 난방 제어를 위한 심층 강화 학습: 엔드 투 엔드 사례 연구
items.summary_ko: 건물의 높은 열 관성과 바닥 난방 시스템의 느린 동적 응답으로 인해 히트 펌프(HP)와 연결된 바닥 난방(UFH) 시스템을 효율적으로 제어하는 것이 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 에너지 소비와 열 쾌적성을 동시에 최적화하는 DRL(Deep Reinforcement Learning) 기반 제어 접근 방식을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: DRL을 활용한 지능형 건물 에너지 관리 시스템은 에너지 효율을 높이고 탄소 배출량을 줄이는 데 기여하며, 이는 스마트 시티 및 지속 가능한 기술 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: FrameRouter: Frame Budget Routing for Long-Video Understanding on Video-MME-v2 and Beyond
items.body: Long-video question answering benchmarks like Video-MME-v2 typically evaluate systems under a uniform frame budget for every question, despite stark variation in the evidence each query actually demands. We analyze this mismatch on Video-MME-v2 and find that different question subsets prefer different frozen frame-budget policies, while uniformly increasing the frame count does not reliably improve all metrics. These findings motivate fixed-mean frame-budget routing, a controlled inference setting in which each question may receive a different frame budget while the average budget matches a uniform reference. We introduce FrameRouter, a training-free test-time framework that combines an evidence-demand router, a budget-constrained allocation rule, and a frozen bank of frame-sampling policies. By controlling how much visual evidence each question receives while leaving the underlying samplers unchanged, FrameRouter is orthogonal to query-aware frame selection. Across Video-MME-v2 and several long-video understanding benchmarks, FrameRouter improves long-video question answering by using the same average visual budget more selectively across questions. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/FrameRouter.
items.title_ko: FrameRouter: Video-MME-v2 및 장기 비디오 이해를 위한 프레임 예산 라우팅
items.summary_ko: Video-MME-v2와 같은 장기 비디오 질문 답변 벤치마크에서 모든 질문에 동일한 프레임 예산을 할당하는 것의 비효율성을 분석하고, '고정 평균 프레임 예산 라우팅'이라는 새로운 추론 설정을 제안합니다. 이는 질문마다 필요한 증거의 양이 다르다는 점을 활용합니다.
items.why_ko: 장기 비디오 이해 모델의 효율성을 높이는 프레임 예산 라우팅 기술은 대규모 비디오 데이터 처리 및 분석 비용을 절감하는 데 중요하며, 이는 멀티모달 AI 개발에 유용합니다.

items.title: ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.body: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. A shared blend-aware color refinement network with only 44.7K parameters refines an analytic color update to realize either color mapping without rendering. It preserves geometry and delivers standard 3DGS assets in seconds. We also design the ReTouch3D benchmark to support the evaluation of aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer across viewpoints. Experiments demonstrate high color accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenes in both aesthetic color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.
items.title_ko: ReTouchGS: 3D 가우시안 스플래팅을 위한 초경량 렌더 프리 심미적 색상 강화 및 전이
items.summary_ko: 3D 가우시안 스플래팅(3DGS)이 사실적인 장면 재구성을 가능하게 하지만, 기존 색상 전이 및 편집 방법은 참조 이미지나 사용자 지정 조정에 의존합니다. ReTouchGS는 참조 없이 장면을 자동으로 시각적으로 더욱 매력적으로 만드는 미적 색상 강화 및 전이를 위한 최초의 프레임워크를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 3D 그래픽스 분야에서 AI 기반의 심미적 색상 강화 기술은 콘텐츠 제작의 효율성을 높이고, 3D 장면의 시각적 품질을 자동으로 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
items.body: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. It is used to train the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D magnetic levitation system that is learned purely from simulated physics. We show that the learned neural controller transfers zero-shot from simulation to real hardware while satisfying hard real-time constraints at 4 kHz. The learned controller achieves qualitatively new behaviors and even levitates a mover topology for which no hand-crafted solution exists. These results demonstrate that co-design is not a physical necessity for 6D magnetic levitation control. More broadly, control learning from simulated physics can find solutions beyond the reach of control engineering in demanding industrial domains. Source code and demonstration videos are publicly available at https://sites.google.com/view/magflow.
items.title_ko: Magflow: 산업 등급 6D 자기 부상에 대한 미분 가능한 시뮬레이션
items.summary_ko: 6자유도(6D) 자기 부상은 마찰 없는 운송과 마이크로미터 스케일 위치 지정을 가능하게 하지만, 복잡하고 불안정한 동역학으로 인해 저수준 제어가 어렵습니다. Magflow는 산업 등급 6D 자기 부상에 대한 미분 가능한 시뮬레이션을 제시하여 제어 시스템 개발의 효율성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 물리 시스템에 대한 미분 가능한 시뮬레이션은 AI 기반 제어 시스템의 설계 및 최적화에 혁신적인 도구를 제공하며, 이는 로봇 공학 및 산업 자동화에 중요합니다.

items.title: Reversing the text is not reversing the path: a fixed-text measure without a zero, and an assembly-order comparison that vanishes identically
items.body:
For an ensemble of trajectories the fluctuation theorems give the entropy production its meaning and zero. The same expression has recently been evaluated on one fixed text, $Δ= [\log P(x) - \log P(\tilde x)]/L$ with $\tilde x$ the text in reversed order, read as an entropy production separating causally from arbitrarily ordered prose. A single text is neither a distribution nor a dynamics, and the texts at issue were produced by other models. No theorem fixes where the zero of a fixed-text quantity lies: the expression carries over from an ensemble, its zero does not.
We supply a zero from an exact antisymmetry. Scoring a text's $n$ sentences in all $n!$ orders, reversal carries $π$ to $π\circ \mathrm{rev}$, a measure-preserving involution, so $Δ(π) = -Δ(π\circ \mathrm{rev})$ identically and the values are centred at zero for any score. The authored arrangement's midrank is then unitless, bounded, and 0.50 for a score blind to order. Across five autoregressive evaluators from 124M to 4B parameters, and taking the prompt-defined labels at face value, 8% to 15% of the median midrank's distance from the null is attributable to causal order and the rest to the arrangement being the order the passage was produced in.
The thermodynamic reading needs a comparison whose zero does hold on the text read, and a masked model supplies one: the any-order chain rule gives a genuine log-probability, and its left-to-right and right-to-left orders for one text give $σ$, a comparison of two assembly orders. Both run from the empty sequence to the same text, so it is not a path against its time reverse. It vanishes identically when the evaluator's conditionals come from a joint, and a non-zero reading reports the evaluator's incompatibility, not the text. Neither is a fixed-text entropy production, for different reasons.
items.title_ko: 텍스트 역전과 경로 역전: 고정 텍스트 측정의 부재와 동일하게 사라지는 조립 순서 비교
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 텍스트를 역전시키는 것이 경로를 역전시키는 것과 다르며, 고정된 텍스트에 대한 엔트로피 생성 측정의 한계를 지적합니다. 단일 텍스트가 분포나 동역학이 아니며, 다른 모델에 의해 생성된 텍스트에 대한 엔트로피 측정의 의미를 비판적으로 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 엔트로피 및 정보 이론적 분석에 대한 비판적 고찰은 모델의 성능 평가 및 이해에 있어 오해를 줄이고, 보다 정확한 해석을 위한 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
items.body: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) increasingly forecast real-world events by searching the Web and reasoning over what they find. How well such an agent forecasts depends on both the retrieved evidence and the model, making control over that evidence essential for evaluation. Live evaluations can mix retrieval with reasoning when each system searches on its own, while retrospective search can leak later information through date filters or today's ranking of historical pages. Comparing models, search sources, and memory strategies requires both fixed evidence and a record of how it evolved before resolution. We introduce ForecastGym, which records what four commercial web search APIs return for open prediction-market questions every two days and replays this frozen evidence offline once outcomes are known, comparing models, memory, and captured search sources under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy. Its first release covers 150 questions, 614 evidence states, one per question and collection time, and 131k search results. Rerunning the same queries after settlement returns results that all but state the outcome for up to 92% of the questions, despite the tested date filters. On the frozen evidence, all tested LLMs trail the market in forecasting accuracy. Our diagnostic analysis suggests that missed public information contributes more to the gap in high-gap states than misreading does. Switching the search API changes a model's Brier score by up to 0.043, more than the spread across models, while persistent notes score similarly to rereading all evidence at half the input tokens. The evidence a forecaster sees can matter as much as the model that reads it.
items.title_ko: ForecastGym: 예측 에이전트를 위한 라이브, 제어 및 재생 가능한 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: ForecastGym은 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 기반 예측 에이전트의 성능을 평가하기 위한 라이브, 제어 및 재생 가능한 벤치마크입니다. 웹 검색 및 추론 능력을 평가하며, 증거에 대한 통제가 평가의 필수적임을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 실제 예측 능력을 정확하게 평가할 수 있는 벤치마크는 에이전트 개발 및 개선에 필수적이며, 이는 금융, 기후 등 다양한 분야에 응용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
items.body: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
items.title_ko: 일상 방사선학에서 보이지 않는 것 발견: 물리 기반 3D 자기 지도 학습을 통한 CBCT에서 MRI 검증 연조직 병리 교차 모달 감지
items.summary_ko: 루틴 X선 촬영(CBCT)에서 보이지 않는 연조직 병리를 자기 공명 영상(MRI) 검증을 통해 발견하는 교차 모달 감지 방법을 제안합니다. 물리 기반 3D 자기 지도 학습을 사용하여 CBCT 스캔 내에 물리적으로 보존된 미세한 방사선학적 특징을 추출합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상에서 AI를 활용하여 초기 진단을 개선하는 것은 환자 치료 결과를 크게 향상시킬 수 있으며, 이는 AI 의료 분야 개발에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Variance Restoration over Covariance Rank: Memory-Budgeted Analytic Continual Learning
items.body: Analytic continual learning replaces iterative gradient updates with closed-form ridge regression over frozen pre-trained representations, summarizing all past sessions in two running sufficient statistics: the feature autocorrelation matrix $Σ_t$ and the class cross-correlation matrix $Γ_t$. Lifting backbone features into a wide random code of dimension $M \gg D$ substantially improves linear separability across tasks, but forces $Σ_t$ to grow quadratically as $\mathcal{O}(M^2)$. Under a fixed persistent memory envelope $\Bcal$, a learner faces a fundamental structural trade-off: store exact pairwise co-activations inside a narrower feature code, or expand to a wide code while compressing cross-coordinate interactions. We observe that the coordinate self-variances $v_t = \diag(Σ_t)$ and class statistics $Γ_t$ grow only linearly with $M$, whereas off-diagonal interactions dominate memory. We introduce \method (\textbf{Co}ordinate-\textbf{Re}stored \textbf{A}nalytic \textbf{C}ontinual \textbf{L}earning), which retains $(v_t, Γ_t)$ exactly, maintains off-diagonal co-activations through a streaming rank-$q$ factor $F_t$, restores exact diagonal variances via $\Sighat_t = F_t^\top F_t + \Diag(v_t - \diag(F_t^\top F_t))$, and solves the full $M\times C$ normal equations via the Woodbury identity. Across five class-incremental benchmarks on frozen ViT-B/16, \method matches dense full-covariance readouts within $0.09$ points while cutting persistent state by $90.7\%$ ($35.9$ vs.\ $385.3$ MiB). Under equal memory envelopes of $16$--$80$ MiB, prioritizing expansion width $M$ over covariance rank $q$ outperforms exact narrow readouts in $17$ of $18$ configurations by up to $+2.19$ points.
items.title_ko: 공분산 랭크에 따른 분산 복원: 메모리 예산 분석적 연속 학습
items.summary_ko: 분석적 연속 학습은 반복적인 경사 업데이트를 고정된 사전 학습된 표현에 대한 닫힌 형식 릿지 회귀로 대체하여 효율성을 높입니다. 이 연구는 메모리 제약 하에서 특징 자기 상관 행렬과 클래스 교차 상관 행렬을 효율적으로 관리하여 연속 학습 성능을 유지하는 방법을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 메모리 제약 환경에서의 효율적인 연속 학습은 AI 모델이 끊임없이 새로운 데이터를 학습하고 업데이트하는 데 중요하며, 이는 에지 AI 및 지속 학습 시스템 개발에 유용합니다.

items.title: When Anchors Shift the Target: Advantage-Gated Adaptation for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Forward-process reinforcement learning adapts diffusion and flow-matching models by re-noising rewarded generations into regression targets. Because negative advantages induce concave updates with unbounded repulsive gradients, existing methods stabilize training using cached predictions from a moving policy copy, yet these anchors also alter what positive feedback teaches the model to fit. We formalize this conflict as anchor coupling: after separating frozen-reference regularizers, affine moving-anchor rules cannot eliminate negative curvature while preserving every positive regression target. We propose Advantage-Gated Adaptation (AGA) to decouple these roles. Positive samples retain standard target fitting, whose self-limiting update vanishes at the observed target independently of the moving anchor. Negative samples instead use the first-order tangent of the concave objective at the moving-policy prediction, preserving the local repulsion direction with a prediction-independent gradient. Within the quadratic-anchor family, these requirements uniquely determine the parameter-free gate $ω(a)=\max(-a,0)$. Because the moving copy provides local linearization rather than retention, AGA assigns long-horizon behavior preservation to a frozen pretrained reference regularized at its operating classifier-free guidance scale, interpreted through an implicit-reward lens. Across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, our experiments show that displacing positive targets degrades visual quality and heightens sensitivity to policy-copy schedules, whereas AGA consistently improves the reward--quality trade-off.
items.title_ko: 앵커가 타겟을 바꾸는 경우: 확산 강화 학습을 위한 이점-게이팅 적응
items.summary_ko: 확산 및 흐름 매칭 모델을 강화 학습에 적용하는 순방향 프로세스 강화 학습에서 앵커(moving policy copy)가 긍정적 피드백이 모델에 가르치는 것을 변경할 수 있는 '앵커 커플링' 문제를 formalize합니다. 이 충돌을 해결하기 위한 이점-게이팅 적응 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 확산 모델 기반 강화 학습의 안정성과 효율성을 높이는 것은 AI 에이전트의 학습 성능을 향상시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 복잡한 환경에서의 자율 학습 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: Storing the Gemma 4 K=V Cache Once: Exact Global-KV Memory Savings in a Paged Serving Engine with Unchanged Attention Kernels
items.body: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.
items.body_ko: Gemma 4 31B의 전역 어텐션 계층에서, 값(value)은 정규화된 키 투영(key projection)이며, 키(key)는 고정된 가중치로 스케일링된 값에 해당하며, 차원의 1/4에 로터리 위치 인코딩이 적용됩니다. Gemma 4 보고서는 이러한 설계가 전역 KV 캐시를 최대 37.5%까지 줄인다고 명시하지만, 우리가 확인한 오픈 서빙 엔진들은 여전히 완전한 키와 완전한 값을 저장합니다: KV 헤드 및 토큰당 1,024개의 값. 우리는 대신 640개 값의 행 하나를 저장하며, 이는 실수 산술에서 정확하고, 변경되지 않은 페이징된 어텐션 커널이 두 개의 겹치는 스트라이드 뷰를 통해 이를 키 캐시와 값 캐시로 읽습니다. 16비트 31B 모델을 사용하는 vLLM 프로토타입에서, 출력은 스톡 캐시에서 동일한 산술을 에뮬레이션한 것과 비트 단위로 동일하며, 432개의 최종 답변 중 2개가 스톡 엔진과 다릅니다(엔진의 실행 간 노이즈 범위 내). 그리고 요청당 안정적인 디코드 KV 메모리는 32K에서 64K 토큰에서 1.34배에서 1.40배 감소합니다. NIXL 전송 및 CPU 오프로드를 사용하는 두 대의 A100 GPU의 프리필/디코드 쌍에서, 완전한 15GiB 풀을 가진 디코드 엔진은 16K 토큰 프롬프트의 경우 스톡 디코드 토큰당 1.38배(0.06%까지 반복), 8K 토큰 프롬프트의 경우 1.24배의 스텝을 실행했습니다. vLLM 블록 풀 모델은 두 비율 모두 1% 이내로 예측했으며(엔진이 0.7%에서 0.9% 더 높음), 그들 사이의 변화와 일치했습니다. 이른 디코드 처리량은 1.30배 및 1.11배 증가했으며, 이 경로에서 컴팩트 엔진은 배치 1에서 8개의 프롬프트에 대해 에뮬레이션과 동일한 출력 토큰을 제공했습니다. 런타임 프로토타입은 동일 배치에서 이른 스텝을 4%에서 9% 더 느리게 만들며, 이 방법은 기본 스케일에서 8비트 KV 캐시와 아직 스택되지 않습니다.
items.title_ko: Gemma 4 K=V 캐시를 한 번만 저장: Paged Serving Engine에서 정확한 전역 KV 메모리 절약
items.summary_ko: Gemma 4 31B의 전역 어텐션 레이어에서 키와 값이 밀접하게 연관되어 있어, 현재 대부분의 서빙 엔진이 전체 키와 값을 저장하는 비효율성을 개선합니다. 이 연구는 한 640-value 행만 저장하여 Gemma 4의 전역 KV 캐시를 37.5%까지 절약할 수 있는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: KV 캐시 최적화는 LLM 서빙 비용을 크게 줄이고, 더 많은 사용자가 AI 서비스를 이용할 수 있도록 합니다. 이는 개발자가 AI 모델을 효율적으로 배포하고 운영하는 데 중요한 실무 지식입니다.

items.title: Check Your Blind Spots: Decision-Guided Perception by Probing the Planner with Hypothetical Objects
items.body: Not every perception error changes the planner's action. Yet adaptive-resolution perception chooses where to spend high-resolution computation from image cues, which can neither reliably point to an object that low resolution missed nor tell which objects matter to the planner. We observe that the planner can say where an object would matter before anything is seen: inserting a hypothetical object at a location tests whether its action would change. Decision-Guided Speculative Perception (DGSP) treats the low-resolution scene and its action as a draft and probes the planner in this way to obtain a decision-sensitivity field, the locations where an unseen object would change the action. Only this field and the support, the detections on which the current action rests, are verified at high resolution, repeatedly until the action is stable. For two planner classes, we prove that DGSP returns exactly the action of whole-frame high-resolution perception if crop detections match whole-frame ones and the crops cover the field, conditions that real images meet approximately. On three driving datasets, it reproduces this action on about 98% of frames with about a quarter of the pixels. At the pixel cost of uniform downscaling, it repairs more of the draft's disagreements with this action, brakes falsely less often, and recovers many more of the decision-relevant objects that the draft misses.
items.title_ko: 사각지대 확인: 가상의 객체로 플래너를 탐지하여 의사결정-유도 인식
items.summary_ko: 자율 시스템에서 지각 오류가 항상 플래너의 행동을 바꾸는 것은 아니지만, 적응형 해상도 지각은 이미지 단서로부터 높은 해상도 계산을 어디에 할당할지 결정합니다. 이 연구는 '의사결정-유도 추측 지각(DGSP)'을 제안하여, 가상의 객체를 삽입함으로써 플래너가 어떤 객체를 중요하게 여기는지 파악합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율 시스템의 지각 및 의사결정 능력을 향상시키는 것은 안전하고 효율적인 자율 주행, 로봇 공학 시스템 개발에 필수적입니다.

items.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
items.body: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. With native support for stream sharding under TP, TPHC requires only 9% more training time than mHC on an 8B model when both use four streams. Increasing the number of streams from four to sixteen raises its training time by only 19%. On a 1.1B model trained on 100B tokens, TPHC reduces validation loss by 0.7-1.0% and raises average zero-shot accuracy across six commonsense reasoning benchmarks by 0.3-0.7 percentage points relative to mHC at matched stream counts $N\in\{4,8,16\}$. Our code is available at https://github.com/wuyou2002/TPHC.
items.title_ko: TPHC: 텐서 병렬 그룹 업데이트로 하이퍼-연결 개선
items.summary_ko: 하이퍼-연결(HC)은 트랜스포머의 잔차 스트림을 N개의 병렬 스트림으로 확장하지만, 각 하위 레이어가 모든 스트림에 단일 출력을 작성하여 스트림 간 독립성을 제한합니다. 이 연구는 텐서 병렬(TP) 샤드를 HC 스트림과 통합하여 스트림 간 독립성을 증진하는 TPHC를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 트랜스포머 모델의 병렬 처리 효율성을 높이는 것은 대규모 AI 모델의 훈련 속도와 성능을 향상시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 LLM 개발자에게 유용한 기술입니다.

items.title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
items.body: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)
items.title_ko: PeriaTrace: 치근단 방사선 사진에서 치아 수준 접지 진단 및 환자용 설명
items.summary_ko: 치근단 방사선 사진(PRs) 해석 및 보고서 작성에 소요되는 시간을 줄이기 위해 치아 수준 진단, 시각적으로 접지된 보고서 생성, 환자 친화적인 설명 및 치료 권장 사항을 통합한 3단계 프레임워크 PeriaTrace를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 진단에 AI를 활용하여 진단 정확도를 높이고 환자 소통을 개선하는 것은 의료 서비스의 질을 향상시키는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: PhysScope: Agentic Multimodal Physics Reasoning with Grounded Visual Memory
items.body: Vision-language models (VLMs) can correctly interpret physics diagrams yet apply constraints outside the states or conditions in which they hold, causing premise errors to propagate through subsequent calculations. We introduce PhysScope, an inference-time visual harness that supports self-correction of these scope mismatches without updating model weights. PhysScope enables the model to link physical scopes directly to its visual observations and explicitly constructs derived views to support reasoning. The harness imposes explicit constraints on state distinctions, conditions, and physical scopes during model reasoning, and checks agent-proposed revisions against sources and scopes. Accepted revisions invalidate registered dependents, thereby maintaining scope-aware working memory. On PhysAlign, PhysScope achieves higher solving scores than direct solving across all six evaluated VLMs. With Gemini-3.8-flash, it outperforms Canvas-CoT by 9.34 percentage points and substantially improves solving accuracy on the out-of-distribution (OOD) PhysUniBench benchmark. Ablation studies support explicit scope management and dependency maintenance as design principles for multimodal physics reasoning agents.
items.title_ko: PhysScope: 접지된 시각적 메모리를 이용한 에이전트 기반 다중 모달 물리학 추론
items.summary_ko: 비전-언어 모델(VLM)이 물리학 다이어그램을 올바르게 해석하더라도 유효하지 않은 조건에 제약을 적용하여 오류를 발생시키는 문제를 해결합니다. PhysScope는 모델 가중치를 업데이트하지 않고도 이러한 '범위 불일치(scope mismatch)'를 스스로 수정하도록 돕는 추론 시간 시각적 하네스입니다.
items.why_ko: VLM이 복잡한 과학적 추론을 수행할 때 정확성을 높이고 오류를 줄이는 것은 AI 기반 과학 연구의 신뢰성을 향상시키는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
items.body: We introduce Kumo Tabular, a family of open tabular foundation models for classification and regression, in three sizes: Kumo Tabular-S (27M parameters), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), and Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Pretrained only on artificial tables from the Kumo prior, they can make predictions on new tables without any training. In our approach, a table encoder compresses each row into an embedding, and an in-context learning transformer predicts the unlabeled rows from the labeled ones. Kumo Tabular introduces architectural innovations that improve both training stability and predictive performance, enabling the model to scale up to 150M cells on modern GPUs. Kumo Tabular-L ranks first on eight benchmarks: TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, and TabBench-Bio. These cover probabilistic regression, tables with over 1M rows or 100K columns, and tables with strings, text, or images. Accuracy improves with model size in all tested comparisons. All three sizes lie on the accuracy-speed frontiers of TabArena and BeyondArena. Kumo Tabular-L predicts faster than the runners-up, LimiX-2 on TabArena (36 times) and TabPFN-3.5 on BeyondArena (1.7 times). Weights and pretraining code are released under OpenMDW-1.1 and Apache 2.0, respectively.
items.body_ko: 분류 및 회귀를 위한 개방형 테이블 기반 파운데이션 모델 제품군인 Kumo Tabular를 세 가지 크기로 소개합니다: Kumo Tabular-S (27M 매개변수), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), 그리고 Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Kumo 사전에서 인공적으로 생성된 테이블로만 사전 학습되었기 때문에, 어떠한 추가 학습 없이도 새로운 테이블에 대한 예측을 수행할 수 있습니다. 우리의 접근 방식에서는 테이블 인코더가 각 행을 임베딩으로 압축하고, 인컨텍스트 학습 트랜스포머가 레이블이 지정된 행으로부터 레이블이 지정되지 않은 행을 예측합니다. Kumo Tabular는 학습 안정성과 예측 성능을 모두 향상시키는 아키텍처 혁신을 도입하여, 현대 GPU에서 최대 1억 5천만 개의 셀로 모델을 확장할 수 있게 합니다. Kumo Tabular-L은 TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, TabBench-Bio 등 8개의 벤치마크에서 1위를 차지했습니다. 이 벤치마크들은 확률적 회귀, 1백만 개 이상의 행 또는 10만 개 이상의 열을 가진 테이블, 문자열, 텍스트 또는 이미지를 포함하는 테이블을 다룹니다. 모든 테스트된 비교에서 모델 크기가 커질수록 정확도가 향상됩니다. 세 가지 크기 모두 TabArena 및 BeyondArena의 정확도-속도 프론티어에 위치합니다. Kumo Tabular-L은 TabArena에서 LimiX-2보다 36배, BeyondArena에서 TabPFN-3.5보다 1.7배 빠르게 예측합니다. 가중치 및 사전 학습 코드는 각각 OpenMDW-1.1 및 Apache 2.0 라이선스 하에 공개됩니다.
items.title_ko: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: 표 형식 데이터 예측을 위한 정확도-효율성 선두
items.summary_ko: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular는 분류 및 회귀를 위한 오픈형 표 형식 파운데이션 모델 제품군으로, Kumo Tabular-S(27M), Kumo Tabular-M(61M), Kumo Tabular-L(214M) 세 가지 크기로 제공됩니다. 인공 테이블로만 사전 훈련되어 훈련 없이 새로운 테이블을 예측할 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 표 형식 데이터 예측에 특화된 파운데이션 모델은 기업의 데이터 분석 및 비즈니스 의사결정을 가속화하며, 개발자들이 데이터 사이언스 워크플로우를 효율적으로 구축하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
items.body: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.
items.title_ko: 고정된 월드 모델을 이용한 위험 인식 궤적 선택을 위한 잔차 유도 경량 강화 학습
items.summary_ko: 자율 주행에서 월드 모델은 후보 궤적을 평가하기 위한 미래 장면 예측을 제공하지만, 고정된 선택 규칙은 장면 의존적 트레이드오프를 포착하지 못할 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 고정된 월드 모델과 고정된 후보군을 사용하여 경량 궤적 선택을 위한 잔차 유도 강화 학습(RL) 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 자율 주행 시스템에서 위험 인지 궤적 선택은 안전성을 극대화하는 데 필수적이며, 경량화된 RL 프레임워크는 에지 장치에서의 효율적인 배포를 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
items.body:
Agentic systems using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must repair their own answers by gathering more evidence, testing alternative policies and deciding if, when, and what repairs are needed. Yet how do we know if a system's repairs are working when metrics like accuracy can be misleading? We present RagHarnessDebugger, a framework that records every repair decision in a Jev-guided harness for contract inference and audits the record to facilitate complete debugging of all decisions taken during a RAG repair journey. RagHarnessDebugger checks that each trace is intact, that each validation applies to the candidate it is counted for, and which answers the acceptance rule can reach. We tested our approach on ContractNLI non-disclosure agreements with two reader models and a replication set of separate contracts. Our debugger's audit layer exposed failure patterns that were hidden under aggregate metrics, policies acceptance cost of repairs vs regressions and policy acceptance gap of 77% and 76% of available but unrealised repairs on development and replication sets. Our audit, together with a labeled error analysis and replay mechanism, allowed following the execution path all the way to the terminal decision - uncovering where missing repairs became lost. Our revised harness improved accuracy over the initial BM25-only baseline by 3.6 points on development contracts and 3.7 points on the replication set, and even improved our full contract access reference score by 1.1 on development and 2.4 on replication set. While our work here demonstrates how the debugger can conduct decision root-cause analysis for missed repairs, the true value lies with providing this debugger for judgment visibility serving continuous improvement of RAG decisions and their explainability.
Keywords: agentic RAG, AI evidence repair, harness explainability, counterfactual replay, Jev, ContractNLI
items.title_ko: RagHarnessDebugger: 계약 추론 복구 감사에서 Jev 유도 에이전트 RAG
items.summary_ko: 검색 증강 생성(RAG)을 사용하는 에이전트 시스템은 더 많은 증거를 수집하고, 대안 정책을 테스트하며, 언제 어떤 수리가 필요한지 결정함으로써 스스로 답변을 수정해야 합니다. RagHarnessDebugger는 Jev 유도 하네스를 통해 모든 복구 결정을 기록하고 감사하여 디버깅을 용이하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: RAG 시스템의 디버깅 및 감사 도구는 AI 에이전트의 신뢰성을 높이고, 개발자들이 복잡한 RAG 시스템의 오류를 효과적으로 진단하고 수정하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

items.title: How Web Research Agents Interpret User Priorities
items.body: Web research agents gather information online and write cited reports, including financial analysis. Users can state a priority to guide this research, but a priority may not say how to judge the options, leaving the agent to choose the criteria. We examine how two such agents, built on OpenAI and Anthropic models, interpret a stated priority. In 36 runs, the agents compared Microsoft and Alphabet as businesses. Prompts asked for special attention to growth or resilience, or gave no priority. We analyzed reports, searches, returned sources and cited sources. Of the 24 reports given a priority, 21 focused on it, but their criteria varied. Under the growth priority, OpenAI reports that ranked the companies accounted for risk or predictability and favored Microsoft, while the Anthropic ones judged growth by its pace and favored Alphabet. Under the resilience priority, reports used partly different criteria, and most named Microsoft as the more resilient company. Of the search and source measures tested, only the Anthropic agent's search wording differed detectably by condition. These findings suggest evaluations should examine the criteria behind a report's judgements, not only its focus or accuracy. Interfaces could let users see and adjust those criteria.
items.title_ko: 웹 연구 에이전트가 사용자 우선순위를 해석하는 방식
items.summary_ko: 웹 연구 에이전트가 온라인에서 정보를 수집하고 인용된 보고서를 작성할 때, 사용자의 우선순위를 어떻게 해석하는지 연구합니다. OpenAI와 Anthropic 모델을 기반으로 구축된 두 에이전트가 성장 또는 회복력에 대한 우선순위를 부여받았을 때 마이크로소프트와 알파벳을 어떻게 비교하는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 사용자의 의도와 우선순위를 정확히 이해하는 것은 에이전트의 유용성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 중요하며, 이는 개발자가 효과적인 프롬프트를 설계하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

items.title: Structured AI ideation yields physical strategies for epithelial barrier repair
items.body: AI systems increasingly support literature analysis, candidate evaluation and hypothesis refinement, but enabling researchers to explore research directions beyond established disciplinary approaches remains challenging. We developed Abelio, an AI system designed to generate novel research directions by expanding investigators' avenues of inquiry. Abelio reformulates research objectives, uses these alternative formulations to identify relevant elements outside conventional disciplinary boundaries, and refines the resulting hypotheses. Each stage integrates divergent exploration with convergent selection through a dedicated subsystem. In quantitative evaluations, proposals generated by the Ideation Core (Abelio's hypothesis-generation core) outperformed those of four frontier large language models in scientific soundness and hypothesis diversity, and three of four in distance from existing literature. Subsystem ablation showed that each subsystem contributes to the property it targets, with the contribution of Element Selection measurable before Refinement. To investigate intestinal epithelial barrier restoration, Abelio proposed physical interventions involving membrane-tethered poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) and cholesterol-anchored complementary DNA. Both proposals were archived before experimentation and subsequently tested independently in damaged Caco-2 monolayers. PEG preserved barrier function in a membrane-surface-dependent manner, whereas complementary DNA enabled sequence-specific restoration that was reversible on demand. These findings demonstrate how structured research ideation can identify experimentally testable approaches beyond established disciplinary conventions.
items.title_ko: 구조화된 AI 아이디어 생성, 상피 장벽 복구를 위한 물리적 전략 제시
items.summary_ko: Abelio는 연구자들이 기존 학문 분야의 접근 방식을 넘어 연구 방향을 탐색할 수 있도록 설계된 AI 시스템입니다. 연구 목표를 재구성하고, 이러한 대안적 공식화를 사용하여 기존 분야 외의 관련 요소를 식별함으로써 상피 장벽 복구를 위한 새로운 물리적 전략을 생성했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 과학 연구에서 새로운 아이디어를 생성하고 학제 간 연구를 촉진하는 능력은 생명 공학 및 의학 분야에 혁신적인 솔루션을 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
items.body: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) in late 2022 has raised questions about the future of science, but assessing their impact requires understanding how scientific practices were already evolving. We analyze 2.5 million full-text papers across five disciplines from 2015 to 2025, tracing trends over a broad spectrum of lexical, structural, epistemological, and social dimensions. Aside from frequency shifts in some words, most pre-2023 trends continued with limited detectable breaks. Among the notable exceptions, growth in computer science coauthor teams accelerated significantly in Asia, while apparent declines in biomedical topic diversity largely reflected standardization in article formats. Our study establishes an empirical foundation for monitoring the health of global science as LLM adoption deepens.
items.title_ko: 대규모 언어 모델은 아직 과학을 변화시키지 못했다
items.summary_ko: 2022년 말 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)의 등장은 과학의 미래에 대한 질문을 제기했지만, 2015년부터 2025년까지 5개 분야 250만 편의 논문을 분석한 결과, 대부분의 과학적 관행은 2023년 이전의 추세를 이어갔으며 LLM으로 인한 큰 변화는 감지되지 않았습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 과학 연구에 미치는 영향을 객관적으로 평가하는 것은 AI 기술의 실제 가치를 이해하고, 과도한 기대보다는 현실적인 적용 방안을 모색하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
items.body: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.
items.title_ko: VITAL: 제약 약물 개발 및 임상 시험 운영에서 에이전트 AI 검증 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 제약 분야에서 에이전트 기반 AI의 유효성을 검증하고 모니터링하기 위한 VITAL(Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence) 프레임워크를 개발했습니다. 기존 보증 접근 방식이 레퍼런스 표준이 없는 상황에서 에이전트 AI의 오류를 가릴 수 있다는 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 제약과 같이 규제가 엄격한 분야에서 AI 에이전트의 안전하고 효과적인 사용을 위한 검증 프레임워크는 AI 기술 도입의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: SEAM: Computer-Use Agents Know the Harm Between Screens, and Commit It Anyway
items.body: Safety benchmarks for computer-use agents (CUAs) place the harm either in the intent of the task or on a single screen: a malicious instruction, an injected command, a phishing page. An agent that checks the task and each screen in isolation can pass them, so they do not test whether it combines facts seen on different screens. Yet in delegated work, harm often arises exactly this way: a fact about a person on one screen, a fact about an item on another, and a legitimate task that binds them. We introduce SEAM (Safety Execution Across Multiple screens), a benchmark of such cross-screen compositional harm: 600 multi-step, cross-application OSWorld tasks in which the instruction and every single observation are benign and only their combination is harmful. Minimal-pair variants that differ in one place, scored from the server log rather than by an LLM judge, locate where an agent fails. General-purpose open-weight and flagship agents carry out the harm in up to 92% of runs, yet decline when the user states it in one sentence. Agents open the decisive pages, so exposure is not the primary bottleneck. Asked about those pages, they flag the harm, and with thinking they often write the conflict into their reasoning and confirm anyway. Safety recognition thus does not reliably translate into safe execution, and the translation depends on the information channel: the same warning stops agents far more often in the user's instruction than on screen. Proprietary models are markedly more cautious. We release SEAM with its generator and quality gates at https://yuxuan2003.github.io/SEAM/ .
items.title_ko: SEAM: 컴퓨터 사용 에이전트, 화면 간 유해성 인지 및 실행
items.summary_ko: 컴퓨터 사용 에이전트(CUA)의 안전성 벤치마크는 주로 단일 화면에서의 유해성에 초점을 맞춥니다. SEAM은 에이전트가 다른 화면에서 얻은 정보를 결합하여 유해한 행동을 저지를 수 있는 '화면 간 유해성' 문제를 지적하고, 이를 해결하기 위한 테스트 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 다중 화면 환경에서의 안전성 문제는 실제 위협으로 이어질 수 있으므로, 이를 예측하고 방지하는 기술은 AI 보안 연구에 중요한 과제입니다.

items.title: CodeReel: Accelerating Code-to-Video Agents with Exact Frame Reuse and Blocking-Aware Scheduling
items.body: Coding agents make videos by writing and refining programs in a build--inspect--edit loop. A finished film costs a median of $2.85 in model calls and 11 minutes, over a third of that time in builds that block the agent. We find that much of this time is avoidable, for two reasons. First, 37.5% of the frames of a session's later films were drawn before, many shifted in time or inside an edited scene. Second, half of the builds stop at a check, where the agent needs only the verdict, but which builds stop is unknown until the checks finish. We present CodeReel, a training-free execution layer behind agents' existing commands. Exact frame reuse keys each frame by its drawing commands, regardless of its position in time, and reuses each frame whose key recurs. Blocking-aware scheduling runs the checks first and starts the render alongside them, at idle priority, unless the session's recent builds make a pass unlikely. Scheduling spends CPU to answer sooner and reuse returns it; exact keys let later versions use frames rendered for a failed one as the agent thinks. We introduce EditLoop, a benchmark of replayable agent sessions whose films are checked against renders from scratch. On it, CodeReel cuts the agent's wait by 36.3% against Rebuild, a warm pipeline with parallel rendering, and by 57.9% against Sequential, today's step-by-step pipeline. On time-shifting edits its reuse renders 43.9%, close to the 43.0% whose pixels are new, while Manim-style caching renders 99.8%. With real agents, the median wait per build is 0.62x Rebuild's in Claude Code, on topics never used in development, and 0.67x in Codex CLI. The gain holds for five models and two frameworks.
items.title_ko: CodeReel: 정확한 프레임 재사용 및 블로킹 인식 스케줄링으로 코드-비디오 에이전트 가속화
items.summary_ko: 코드-비디오 에이전트가 비디오를 만들 때 발생하는 높은 모델 호출 비용과 긴 처리 시간을 줄이기 위해 CodeReel을 제안합니다. 이 시스템은 이전 세션의 프레임을 재사용하고 블로킹을 인지하는 스케줄링을 통해 빌드 시간을 단축하고 효율성을 높입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 콘텐츠 생성 워크플로우의 효율성을 높이는 것은 개발 비용을 절감하고 생산성을 향상시키는 데 중요하며, 이는 AI 창작 도구의 상용화를 가속화합니다.

items.title: High-Dimensional Black-Box Optimization via Guidance Sampling of Diffusion Models
items.body: Many real-world optimization problems involve optimizing black-box objectives for which only a limited number of evaluations are available. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful framework for such problems, but its effectiveness often deteriorates in high-dimensional spaces. Recent work leverages diffusion models for black-box optimization, often through pre-training a reward-conditioned score network to steer generation towards high-reward samples. Alternatively, gradient-based guidance methods assume access to a differentiable reward function from which guidance gradients are queried. However, these approaches either require large amounts of labeled data for offline training or access to exact reward gradients, limiting their applicability in black-box settings. We propose BReaD (Black-box Reward-guided Sampling of Diffusion Model), a guidance sampling framework for optimizing black-box rewards without assuming access to a labeled dataset or reward gradients. The proposed method uses a Gaussian process (GP) as a differentiable surrogate for the unknown objective and actively queries labels for the generated samples. We provide a theoretical analysis of the total-variation distance between the generated distribution and the target distribution. Using Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) as guidance signals, our method balances exploration and exploitation during generation and enables the discovery of high-reward regions in the data space. Numerical experiments on scientific discovery and image generation tasks demonstrate that our framework can effectively optimize black-box rewards in low-data scenarios.
items.title_ko: 확산 모델의 가이던스 샘플링을 통한 고차원 블랙박스 최적화
items.summary_ko: 제한된 수의 평가만 가능한 고차원 블랙박스 최적화 문제에서 확산 모델을 활용하는 새로운 접근 방식을 제안합니다. 보상 조건부 스코어 네트워크를 사전 훈련하여 높은 보상 샘플로 생성을 유도하거나, 경사 기반 가이던스 방법을 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 블랙박스 최적화는 AI 모델 튜닝, 재료 과학 등 다양한 분야에서 중요한 문제이며, 확산 모델을 활용한 해결책은 탐색 효율성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
items.body: Pixel-space diffusion learns visual representations and image generation jointly in a single end-to-end training stage, without a separately pretrained visual encoder. However, plain pixel-space Transformers still trail leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency. We hypothesize that part of this gap arises from retaining one token per patch throughout the backbone, which does not explicitly encourage a visual hierarchy that summarizes related content at progressively coarser levels. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens and represent each group with a single token. The main Transformer bottleneck processes these compact group tokens, and ungrouping restores features to their original image positions. A compression budget regulates the average compression ratio across the batch, allowing group memberships and counts to vary across images and diffusion timesteps during both training and generation. The model exhibits emergent semantic structure, learning to group coherent objects and object parts without segmentation labels. In text-to-image generation, HiT further learns to group caption words with image patches depicting the same concepts, without region annotations. HiT achieves 1.48 FID on ImageNet $256\times256$ and reaches comparable generation quality to JiT using approximately 40\% of its cumulative training FLOPs. For text-to-image generation, HiT exceeds UniLiP's average score across five benchmarks with roughly $6\times$ fewer denoiser parameters and $3\times$ fewer forward FLOPs. These results suggest that learning a visual hierarchy within the generator breaks down the barrier to stronger image generation without external visual pretraining.
items.title_ko: 계층적 확산 트랜스포머: 엔드-투-엔드 이미지 생성
items.summary_ko: 픽셀 공간 확산은 별도로 사전 훈련된 시각 인코더 없이도 시각 표현과 이미지 생성을 단일 엔드-투-엔드 훈련 단계에서 공동으로 학습합니다. 이 연구는 계층적 확산 트랜스포머를 통해 기존 latent diffusion 모델과의 성능 격차를 줄이는 방법을 제안합니다.
